items.title: AI產業出口暢旺 三三會示警：傳產仍辛苦、台灣應融入全球供應鏈
items.title_en: AI Industry Exports Surge; 33 Association Warns Traditional Sectors Still Struggle, Taiwan Should Integrate into Global Supply Chains
paras: 據財政部公布上(9)月進出口統計，在AI熱潮帶動下，單月出口年增率超過60%，出口呈現「連35紅」，締造史上最長成長期，三三會理事長林伯豐今(21)日受訪時表示，台灣整體景氣偏正面，製造、軍工與科技業發展，皆有正面的實力與發展空間，但傳產仍辛苦，台灣不應只依賴美國，要思考如何融入全球供應鏈。
三三企業交流會今(21)日舉行10月份例會，以「AI新趨勢與企業AI轉型」邀集Google台灣區前董事總經理簡立峰演講。
據統計，台灣9月外銷訂單為1,142.1億美元，前3季接單高達8,192億美元，也提早刷新全年度新高，呈現AI強勁需求帶動台灣經濟的蓬勃發展，面對台灣如何維持競爭優勢，成為產業界關注焦點。
對此，林伯豐受訪時表示，目前台灣在製造業、軍工與科技發展上一向有實力，也有發展空間，對整體景氣看法正面，台灣過去累積的製造與科技實力，是繼續發展的重大基礎，當產業擴大投資，能否找到足夠且適合的人力，也成為維持競爭力的重要環節。
對經濟部公告出口訂單持續暢旺，林伯豐表示，主要受惠AI相關需求強勁、出口暢旺，半導體與伺服器等供應鏈持續擴大投資，但部分傳統製造業目前經營相當辛苦，在人才培育與引進上仍需要努力，政府在評估整體經濟發展時，也應兼顧不同產業的實際處境。
此外，美國近期即將舉行期中選舉，林伯豐認為，台灣應關注期中選舉後的變化，也呼籲台灣企業在因應全球產業變局時，切忌將全球供應鏈的發展過度寄託於美國，而應以台灣立場為主，思考如何融入全球供應鏈。
針對台灣缺電問題上，林伯豐也重申，企業投資必須考慮供電能力、穩定性與電價，多項條件都會影響後續生產與營運安排，他也再次表達支持核電應迅速重啟的立場，並以日本經歷核災後，仍持續發展核電為例，主張台灣應重新思考能源選擇。
paras_en: According to the Ministry of Finance’s September import‑export statistics, the AI boom drove a month‑over‑month export growth rate of over 60%, delivering a "35‑month streak of red" and setting the longest growth period on record. In an interview on the 21st, 33 Association chairman Lin Bo‑feng said Taiwan’s overall economic outlook is relatively positive, with manufacturing, defense and technology sectors having solid strength and development potential, but traditional industries remain hard‑pressed. Taiwan should not rely solely on the United States and must consider how to embed itself in the global supply chain.

The 33 Enterprise Exchange Association held its October regular meeting on the 21st, inviting former Google Taiwan regional CEO Jian Li‑feng to speak on “New AI Trends and Corporate AI Transformation.”

Statistics show Taiwan’s September export orders amounted to US$114.21 billion, and total orders for the first three quarters reached US$819.2 billion, already breaking the projected annual high. The strong AI‑driven demand is fueling robust economic growth, and how Taiwan can maintain its competitive edge has become a focal point for industry leaders.

In the interview, Lin Bo‑feng emphasized that Taiwan has long possessed strength and room for growth in manufacturing, defense and technology, and he holds a positive view of the overall economy. The manufacturing and tech capabilities accumulated over the years form a major foundation for continued development, and as industries expand investment, securing sufficient and suitable talent will be a key factor in sustaining competitiveness.

Regarding the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ announcement that export orders remain robust, Lin attributed the trend mainly to strong AI‑related demand and vigorous exports, with semiconductor and server supply chains continuing to expand investment. However, some traditional manufacturers are currently struggling, and talent cultivation and recruitment still require effort. He urged the government, when assessing overall economic development, to also consider the real conditions of different sectors.

He also noted that the United States will soon hold its mid‑term elections, and Taiwan should monitor post‑election changes. Lin cautioned Taiwanese firms not to overly hinge the development of the global supply chain on the United States, but to prioritize Taiwan’s own position and think about how to integrate into the worldwide supply network.

Addressing Taiwan’s power shortage, Lin reiterated that corporate investment must take into account electricity capacity, reliability and pricing, as these factors affect production and operational planning. He reiterated his support for a swift restart of nuclear power, citing Japan’s continued nuclear development after its nuclear disaster as an example, and argued that Taiwan should re‑evaluate its energy choices.

items.title: 〈力積電法說〉Q4營收估季增雙位數 明年成熟製程代工價格再漲10-20%
items.title_en: Powerchip Semiconductor Q4 Revenue Expected Double‑Digit Quarterly Growth; Mature‑Process Foundry Prices to Rise 10‑20% Next Year
paras: 力積電(6770-TW)今(21)日召開法說，經營團隊表示，受惠記憶體供需持續吃緊、邏輯晶圓代工價格調漲，以及3D AI Foundry相關產品逐步恢復出貨，預期第四季營收可望季增雙位數；明年在AI需求動能不減下，對營收及獲利表現抱持期待，成熟製程代工價格規劃再調漲10%至20%，並積極與客戶協商長期供貨合約(LTA)，提前綁定明年價量。
力積電指出，全球DRAM市場仍處於供需失衡狀態，AI伺服器採用的高頻寬記憶體(HBM)持續消耗大廠先進製程產能，加上記憶體大廠逐步退出利基型DRAM市場，帶動相關代工需求及價格維持高檔。與美光合作的DRAM 1P製程進展順利，初版製程設計套件(PDK)預計年底前完成，相關機台將於2027年第一季前到位，第二季進入試產。
NAND Flash方面，隨三星、鎧俠逐步退出MLC NAND供應，市場短缺促使部分工控及消費電子廠商轉向SLC NAND，力積電已將SLC NAND代工平台轉向更具競爭力的24奈米製程，並與客戶合作開發MLC NAND產品，預計2026年底進入新產品NTO階段。此外，AI伺服器帶動大容量NOR Flash需求，目前市場供不應求，力積電也可望受惠相關代工需求。
邏輯代工方面，第三季8吋及12吋晶圓代工產能持續吃緊，針對非年度綁約客戶，部分投片價格較第二季調高10%至15%，平均價格調漲約8%至10%。公司指出，下半年晶圓廠產能普遍滿載，成熟製程2026年代工價格已全面調漲，2027年則規劃再漲10%至20%，目前正與客戶協商LTA及明年價量安排。
在AI相關應用方面，力積電的電源管理IC代工已由0.15微米製程切入55奈米BCD製程，相關產品應用於AI伺服器並開始放量，客戶要求簽訂三年長約以確保供貨；MOSFET及IGBT需求也持續吃緊，2027年近80%產能已與客戶簽訂LTA。
3D AI Foundry則是力積電另一項成長布局。公司表示，受銅鑼廠設備大規模停線移機影響，第三季晶圓對晶圓堆疊(WoW)及Interposer產出明顯下滑，相關營收同步減少。隨產線陸續移至新竹廠區並復線，加上積體被動元件(IPD)逐步放量，預期第四季起營收將逐漸恢復，2027年可望逐季上揚。
其中，Interposer預計年底回到滿載投片水位，WoW目前已小量投片試產，預計2027年上半年正式量產；IPD則因AI伺服器功耗提升，需求能見度已延伸至2028年，力積電明年將導入電容密度4500nF新品，應用涵蓋AI伺服器及光通訊模組。至於與美光合作的PWF，預計2026年底前完成試產線設置，2027年第四季進入量產，並可望於2028年成為3D AI Foundry新的成長動能。
力積電指出，由於無塵室空間已用盡，公司已針對台灣、新加坡及日本等地展開新廠調研，聚焦3D AI Foundry產能擴張，並與策略客戶評估共同投資的可行性，為2028年後的市場成長預作準備。
paras_en: Powerchip Semiconductor (6770‑TW) held a briefing today (21st). The management said that, benefiting from continued tight memory supply‑demand, higher logic wafer foundry prices, and the gradual recovery of shipments of 3D AI Foundry products, Q4 revenue is expected to grow double‑digit quarter‑over‑quarter. With AI demand remaining strong next year, the company is optimistic about revenue and profit, planning another 10%‑20% price increase for mature‑process foundry services and actively negotiating long‑term supply agreements (LTA) with customers to lock in next year’s price‑volume in advance.

Powerchip noted that the global DRAM market remains in a supply‑demand imbalance. High‑bandwidth memory (HBM) used in AI servers continues to consume advanced‑process capacity from major fabs, and major memory makers are gradually exiting the niche DRAM market, keeping related foundry demand and prices high. The DRAM 1‑pattern process co‑developed with Micron is progressing smoothly, with the first‑version process design kit (PDK) expected by year‑end and equipment slated to arrive before Q1 2027, entering pilot production in Q2.

Regarding NAND flash, as Samsung and Kioxia gradually withdraw MLC NAND supply, market shortages are pushing some industrial and consumer‑electronics manufacturers toward SLC NAND. Powerchip has shifted its SLC NAND foundry platform to a more competitive 24‑nm process and is co‑developing MLC NAND products with customers, targeting entry into the new‑product NTO phase by the end of 2026. In addition, AI servers are driving demand for high‑capacity NOR flash, which is currently undersupplied, and Powerchip expects to benefit from that demand as well.

In logic foundry, Q3 capacity for 8‑inch and 12‑inch wafers remained tight. For non‑annual‑contract customers, some wafer‑injection prices were raised 10%‑15% versus Q2, with an average price increase of about 8%‑10%. The company said that wafer‑fab capacity was generally fully booked in the second half of the year, mature‑process prices for the 2026 era have already been raised across the board, and a further 10%‑20% increase is planned for 2027. Negotiations on LTAs and next‑year price‑volume arrangements are ongoing.

In AI‑related applications, Powerchip’s power‑management IC foundry has moved from a 0.15‑µm process to a 55‑nm BCD process, with products used in AI servers now ramping up and customers requiring three‑year long‑term contracts to secure supply. Demand for MOSFETs and IGBTs also remains tight, with nearly 80% of 2027 capacity already covered by LTAs with customers.

The 3D AI Foundry is another growth pillar for Powerchip. The company said that large‑scale equipment shutdowns and relocations at the Guola plant caused a noticeable drop in wafer‑on‑wafer (WoW) stacking and interposer output in Q3, reducing related revenue. As production lines are gradually moved to the Hsinchu campus and re‑commissioned, and as integrated passive devices (IPD) scale up, revenue is expected to recover starting in Q4, with quarterly growth anticipated through 2027.

Interposer capacity is expected to return to full‑load wafer‑injection levels by year‑end, while WoW has entered limited pilot production and is slated for volume production in the first half of 2027. IPD demand, driven by higher power consumption in AI servers, now has visibility through 2028; Powerchip will introduce a new 4500 nF capacitor‑density product next year for AI servers and optical‑communication modules. For the Micron‑partnered PWF, pilot‑line setup is expected by the end of 2026, volume production in Q4 2027, and it could become a new growth engine for the 3D AI Foundry in 2028.

Powerchip noted that clean‑room space is already fully utilized, prompting the company to explore new factories in Taiwan, Singapore and Japan, focusing on expanding 3D AI Foundry capacity and evaluating joint‑investment opportunities with strategic customers to prepare for market growth beyond 2028.

items.title: 〈力積電法說〉Q3毛利率約48%創17季高點 純益季增近1倍EPS 1.38元
items.title_en: Powerchip Semiconductor (6770‑TW) Q3 Gross Margin Around 48% Hits 17‑Quarter High, Net Profit Nearly Doubles YoY, EPS NT$1.38
paras: 力積電(6770-TW)今(21)日召開法說會並公告第三季自結財報，第三季稅後純益65億元，季增98%，每股純益1.38元，較去年同期轉盈；累計前三季稅後純益240.22億元，每股純益5.42元，也較去年同期轉盈。
力積電第三季營收213.43億元，季增23.4%、年增80.3%；毛利率47.55%，季增19.3個百分點；營業利益率36.69%，季增15.4個百分點。累計前三季營收522.05億元，年增52.5%；毛利率31.46%、營業利益率49.31%，雙率皆較去年同期由負轉正。
力積電說明，第三季產能利用率由第二季的87%提升至97%，晶圓出貨量約41.6萬片，季減約1.4%、年減約5.5%。第三季晶圓出貨量略減，主要受到銅鑼廠設備搬遷及產能調整影響，不過受惠平均售價及產能利用率提升，帶動營收與獲利改善。
產品銷售組合方面，以製程別來看，24／25／28奈米製程占47%，0.18微米占17%，30奈米及0.11／0.14微米製程各占10%，40／55奈米占7%，0.15微米占4%，63／80／90奈米占3%，0.25微米以上製程占2%。
以產品別來看，DRAM占55%，電源管理晶片(PMIC)占14%，分離式元件(Discrete)占11%，快閃記憶體(Flash)及高壓邏輯驅動晶片(HV)各占6%，嵌入式邏輯產品(IMC)占4%，3D AI Foundry占1.4%，影像感測晶片(CIS)占1%。
paras_en: Powerchip Semiconductor (6770‑TW) held an earnings briefing today (21st) and released its third‑quarter unaudited financial results. Net profit after tax for Q3 was NT$6.5 billion, up 98% sequentially, with earnings per share of NT$1.38, turning to profit compared with the same period last year. Cumulatively for the first three quarters, net profit after tax was NT$24.022 billion, or NT$5.42 per share, also a turnaround from a loss year‑over‑year.

Q3 revenue reached NT$21.343 billion, up 23.4% sequentially and 80.3% year‑over‑year. Gross margin was 47.55%, a sequential increase of 19.3 percentage points. Operating margin stood at 36.69%, up 15.4 percentage points sequentially. For the first three quarters, revenue totaled NT$52.205 billion, up 52.5% year‑over‑year; gross margin was 31.46% and operating margin 49.31%, both turning from negative to positive compared with the prior year.

Powerchip explained that third‑quarter capacity utilization rose from 87% in Q2 to 97%. Wafer shipments were about 416,000 pieces, down roughly 1.4% sequentially and 5.5% year‑over‑year. The slight decline in wafer shipments was mainly due to the relocation of equipment at the Tongluo plant and capacity adjustments, but higher average selling prices and improved capacity utilization drove revenue and profit growth.

In terms of product mix by process node, the 24/25/28 nm processes accounted for 47% of sales, 0.18 µm for 17%, 30 nm and 0.11/0.14 µm each for 10%, 40/55 nm for 7%, 0.15 µm for 4%, 63/80/90 nm for 3%, and processes above 0.25 µm for 2%.

By product category, DRAM contributed 55% of sales, power‑management ICs (PMIC) 14%, discrete components 11%, flash memory and high‑voltage logic drivers each 6%, embedded logic products (IMC) 4%, 3D AI Foundry 1.4%, and image‑sensor ICs (CIS) 1%.

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯同步狂歡！開低走高強勢勁升1.29角收32.488元
items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar and Stocks Celebrate Together! Opens Low, Rises Strong, Gains 0.129 NTD to Close at 32.488
paras: 打破連四黑，台北外匯市場新台幣兌美元今(21)日早盤開低走高，盤中最低貶 8.7 分，午後最高升值1.88角，盤中高低價差達2.75角，匯市多空激烈交戰，終場收在32.488元，升值1.29角，台北外匯成交金額20.59億美元，顯示在熱錢轉向與避險需求交織下，匯市交投異常熱絡。
台幣早盤一度因外資匯出重貶至 32.704 元波段新低，隨台股強彈、外資轉為匯入及相關調節，午後急拉翻紅，終場爆量強升 1.29 角，以 32.488 元作收，終止連四黑。細看匯市全日表現，今日開盤價為 32.630 元，盤中最高升抵 32.429 元、最低貶至 32.704 元，高低價差達 2.75 角。
從國際盤與總體環境觀察，受美股科技股財報與半導體族群走強激勵，那斯達克及費城半導體指數持續反彈，帶動亞洲主要股市與貨幣連動上揚。日元、韓元等主要亞幣對美元普遍回升，吸引國際資金重新回流亞洲新興市場，匯市單邊拋匯壓力明顯緩解，促使台北匯市多頭買盤大舉湧現。
在台股與籌碼面部分，根據證交所最新統計數據，台股今日受到電子權值股發威帶動，終場大漲 594.84 點，收在 46,887.77 點，成交金額達 8,331.91 億元。
三大法人今日合計買超台股 5.68 億元。其中外資及陸資終結連續 10 個交易日的賣超，回頭買超 9.6 億元；投信則連續 9 個交易日力挺，加碼買超 129.19 億元；自營商仍站賣方調節，賣超 133.11 億元。外資由賣轉買並同步於匯市匯入，帶動股匯雙雙止跌回升。
觀察後續市場演變，匯銀人士分析，外資今日展現強烈回流意願，帶動新台幣一舉化解連續重貶破底的危機。目前新台幣收盤重回 32.50 元大關上方，短線重點將觀察外資買超台股的續航力道以及美國通膨數據、聯準會利率政策動向。若熱錢持續湧入，新台幣不排除進一步向 32.30 元關卡挑戰。
整體而言，投資人宜密切關注美股財報週表現、外資於現期貨市場與外匯市場的資金配置幅度，以及亞幣整體的相對強弱，作為後續投資佈局與資產風險控管的依據。
paras_en: Breaking a streak of four consecutive declines, the New Taiwan Dollar in Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market opened lower against the US dollar this morning (21st) but turned higher, falling to a low of 8.7 points before rallying up to 1.88 NTD in the afternoon. The intraday high‑low spread reached 2.75 NTD, reflecting fierce buying‑selling battles, and the session closed at 32.488 NTD, up 1.29 NTD. Taipei’s FX turnover was US$20.59 billion, showing unusually active trading as hot money flows and hedging demand intertwined.

The NT$ briefly slipped to a new intraday low of 32.704 NTD in the early session due to foreign‑capital outflows, but a rebound in the Taiwan stock market, foreign inflows and related adjustments drove a sharp afternoon reversal, ending the day with a strong 1.29 NTD rise to close at 32.488 NTD, ending the four‑day losing streak. Looking at the day’s price action, the opening price was 32.630 NTD, the intraday high was 32.429 NTD, the low was 32.704 NTD, and the high‑low spread was 2.75 NTD.

From the international market and overall environment, US tech earnings and a rally in semiconductor stocks lifted the Nasdaq and Philadelphia Semiconductor indices, which in turn boosted major Asian equity markets and currencies. Major Asian currencies such as the yen and won generally appreciated against the dollar, attracting international capital back to Asian emerging markets. The one‑sided selling pressure in the FX market eased markedly, prompting a flood of bullish buying in Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market.

On the equity side, according to the latest statistics from the Taiwan Stock Exchange, the market was driven by heavyweight electronic stocks, surging 594.84 points to finish at 46,887.77 points with a turnover of NT$8,331.91 billion.

The three major institutional investors bought a net NT$5.68 billion of Taiwanese stocks today. Foreign and mainland investors ended a ten‑day streak of net selling, turning to a net purchase of NT$9.6 billion; investment trusts continued a nine‑day buying streak, adding a net NT$129.19 billion; proprietary traders remained net sellers with a net sale of NT$133.11 billion. The shift of foreign investors from selling to buying, coupled with FX inflows, helped both stocks and the NT$ rebound.

Looking ahead, FX analysts note that foreign investors showed a strong willingness to return today, helping the NT$ quickly resolve the crisis of consecutive sharp depreciations. The NT$ now closed back above the 32.50 NTD threshold; short‑term focus will be on the sustainability of foreign buying in equities, US inflation data, and Fed rate policy. If hot money continues to flow in, the NT$ could further test the 32.30 NTD level.

Overall, investors should closely monitor US earnings reports, the scale of foreign capital allocation in futures and FX markets, and the relative strength of Asian currencies as bases for future investment positioning and asset‑risk management.

items.title: 法國騷亂 贓物湧入二手平台 法國政府勒令下架並追查銷贓
items.title_en: France Riots Flood Second‑Hand Platforms with Stolen Goods; Government Orders Removal and Pursues Sellers
paras: 法國爆發大規模騷亂與洗劫事件，造成全國至少3000家店鋪遭到破壞或搶劫。與此同時，暴徒搶劫獲得的商品隨後竟大量湧現於各大二手線上交易平台，包括 Vinted、Leboncoin、eBay 及 TikTok 等。這些銷贓刊登不僅以遠低於市價的折價兜售，部分商品甚至還帶著未拆除的防盜扣。

暴徒高調轉售贓物

據多家外媒報導，巴黎蒙田大道的 Celine、路易威登（Louis Vuitton）等高級精品店均遭洗劫，美妝通路絲芙蘭（Sephora）未能倖免。二手平台上出現大量全新口紅、香水、智慧型手機及運動球衣。
有賣家以僅10歐元出售一整袋絲芙蘭化妝品，也有人在 TikTok 上公開炫耀搶來的勞力士手錶與名牌包。甚至連法國電競俱樂部 Team Vitality 遭竊的《反恐精英》銀色獎盃，也被掛上 eBay 標價1250歐元拍賣。許多賣家更要求買家透過 Snapchat 私下聯繫，藉此規避平台的審查機制。
在這場暴亂中，許多商戶面臨巨額損失。在巴黎第8區經營餐廳「強強滾」的台灣店主劉欣益表示，店門前道路多次遭人縱火，加上附近的抗議活動升級與地鐵站關閉，即使店面未直接被搶，嚴重的安全風險也讓正常營業難以為繼。

當局約談平台業者

面對線上銷贓亂象，法國政府隨即採取緊急行動，要求各大平台立即刪除可疑商品資訊，並協助警方追查銷贓者。
法國數位事務部長Anne Le Hénanff在社群平台 X 上公開聲明表示：「我們期望這些平台毫不延遲地下架相關商品，他們也被要求與公共當局緊密合作，以便識別並起訴那些轉售潛在贓物的人。」
法國小型企業與商業事務部長Serge Papin指出，當局正協調「調查人員與線上平台之間的合作」，並建立具體機制以識別可疑刊登資訊背後的個人。Papin補充表示，政府將設立專項援助基金，協助受影響的在地企業渡過難關。
二手平台 Vinted 發言人對此回應強調，公司對於販售或教唆購買贓物採取「零容忍」政策，並表示：「自周末以來，我們的團隊已立即採取行動，識別並刪除與掠奪相關的商品刊登，並加強對可疑資訊的監控。」Vinted 補充說明，若發現違規行為，將會採取永久封禁帳戶等懲處。
歐盟委員會發言人Thomas Regnier對此新形態犯罪表示關注，他指出：「線上市場販售掠奪贓物是一個『全新的維度』，歐盟委員會非常樂意與法國當局合作調查。」

商業損失達數億歐元

法國商會與商業組織預估，這場騷亂已對零售業造成數億歐元的直接與間接損失。法國商會主席Alain Di Crescenzo透露，周末的暴力事件影響了數千家企業，損害極為慘重。
家樂福執行長Alexandre Bompard披露，騷亂首日即有約50家門市受嚴重影響，額外安保與停業等衝擊預計將對公司營業利潤造成8000萬至2億歐元的打擊。
為防止治安進一步惡化，法國總理Sébastien Lecornu已指示地方當局在部分地區實施宵禁。法國經濟部同時宣布啟動特殊部分失業補償等援助措施，協助受害商家渡過修復期。
paras_en: Mass riots and looting erupted across France, damaging or robbing at least 3,000 stores nationwide. At the same time, the stolen merchandise swarmed major online resale sites such as Vinted, Leboncoin, eBay and TikTok, often listed at deep discounts and sometimes still bearing anti‑theft tags.

The looters openly resold the loot. According to several foreign media outlets, high‑end boutiques on Paris’s Avenue Montaigne—including Celine and Louis Vuitton—were ransacked, and even beauty retailer Sephora was not spared. The resale platforms soon showed a flood of brand‑new lipsticks, perfumes, smartphones and sports jerseys.

Some sellers posted an entire bag of Sephora cosmetics for just €10, while others flaunted seized Rolex watches and designer bags on TikTok. Even the silver Counter‑Strike trophy stolen from French esports club Team Vitality was listed on eBay for €1,250. Many sellers asked buyers to contact them privately via Snapchat to evade platform moderation.

In the unrest, numerous merchants suffered huge losses. Liu Xinyi, a Taiwanese owner of the restaurant “Qiang Qiang Run” in Paris’s 8th arrondissement, said the road in front of his shop was set on fire repeatedly, protests escalated nearby and the metro station was closed; although his premises were not directly robbed, the severe safety risks made normal operations impossible.

Authorities interview platform operators. Facing the online sale of stolen goods, the French government acted swiftly, demanding that major platforms immediately delete suspicious listings and assist police in tracking the sellers.

France’s Digital Affairs Minister Anne Le Hénanff posted on X that the platforms must take down the items without delay and cooperate closely with public authorities to identify and prosecute those reselling potential loot.

Small‑Business and Trade Minister Serge Papin said the government is coordinating “cooperation between investigators and online platforms” and establishing concrete mechanisms to identify the individuals behind dubious postings. Papin added that a special aid fund will be set up to help affected local businesses weather the crisis.

A Vinted spokesperson stressed the company’s zero‑tolerance policy toward the sale or encouragement of buying stolen goods, saying: “Since the weekend, our team has acted immediately to identify and remove loot‑related listings and to tighten monitoring of suspicious information.” Vinted added that violators will face permanent account bans and other penalties.

EU Commission spokesperson Thomas Regnier expressed concern over this new form of crime, noting: “The online sale of looted goods is a ‘new dimension,’ and the European Commission is very willing to cooperate with French authorities in the investigation.”

Commercial losses run into hundreds of millions of euros. French chambers of commerce estimate the riots have caused direct and indirect losses of several hundred million euros to the retail sector. Chamber president Alain Di Crescenzo said the weekend’s violence affected thousands of businesses with devastating damage.

Carrefour CEO Alexandre Bompard disclosed that about 50 stores were severely impacted on the first day of the riots, and the extra security costs and shutdowns are expected to hit the company’s operating profit by €80 million to €200 million.

To prevent further deterioration of public order, Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu has ordered curfews in certain areas. The Ministry of Economy also announced special partial unemployment compensation and other aid measures to help affected merchants through the recovery period.

items.title: AI 搶電催動核電復活 美國重啟3座反應爐
items.title_en: AI Power Demand Drives Nuclear Power Revival, US Restarts Three Reactors
paras: AI 資料中心用電需求持續攀升之際，美國電力業者正推動重啟 3 座已停機的核反應爐，合計發電容量約 2.25 GW (225 萬瓩)，預計於 2027 年至 2029 年陸續恢復運轉。其中，三哩島計畫獲微軟 (MSFT-US) 20 年購電合約支持，Duane Arnold 計畫則由 NextEra Energy (NEE-US) 與 Google 合作推動。
科技媒體《Tom's Hardware》報導，這 3 項重啟計畫分別位於密西根州的 Palisades 核電廠、賓州三哩島的 Crane 清潔能源中心，以及愛荷華州的 Duane Arnold 能源中心。隨著科技業加速擴建 AI 基礎設施，穩定電力供應與電網接入能力成為重要瓶頸，也讓先前因經濟因素停機的核電機組重新受到關注。
其中，Palisades 核電廠重啟進度最快。報導指出，該廠已於 2026 年 8 月裝填燃料，預計在 2027 年 3 月前後恢復發電，提供約 800 MW (80 萬瓩) 電力。這座電廠先前已進入除役作業，若成功重啟，將成為核反應爐開始除役後恢復運轉的重要先例。
負責該計畫的 Holtec Palisades 已獲美國能源部貸款支持，相關融資源自拜登政府於 2024 年推動的核能投資措施。
賓州三哩島的重啟計畫則由 Constellation Energy (CEG-US) 主導，將恢復 1 號機組運轉，並以 Crane 清潔能源中心之名營運。三哩島曾於 1979 年發生核事故，但當時出事的是 2 號機組，本次重啟對象則是 2019 年停機的 1 號機組。
Constellation 於 2024 年啟動計畫，當時宣布預計投入 16 億美元，並於 2025 年取得美國能源部 10 億美元貸款。微軟已簽署為期 20 年的購電合約，成為這項計畫的主要客戶。
該機組預計於 2027 年恢復運轉，發電容量約 835 MW (83.5 萬瓩)。目前工程主要針對 1 號機組進行設備修復與翻新，裝填燃料前仍須取得美國核能管理委員會 (NRC) 核准。
第三項計畫是 NextEra Energy 與 Google 母公司 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 旗下的 Google 合作，推動愛荷華州 Duane Arnold 能源中心恢復運轉，預計於 2029 年提供約 615 MW (61.5 萬瓩) 電力。
NextEra Energy 執行長 John Ketchum 表示，公司對與 Google 達成的合作協議感到滿意，並強調，相關成本不會由愛荷華州住宅用電戶負擔。
報導指出，這些機組先前停機，主要與營運成本及經濟效益有關。人力與維護支出使核電在與其他發電方式競爭時承受壓力，但 AI 資料中心快速擴張，正改變電力市場的供需與投資條件。
隨著電網接入成為資料中心擴建的重要瓶頸，科技業者取得穩定電力的需求，也為核電重啟提供新的商業誘因。不過，各項計畫能否如期供電，仍取決於工程進度與監管核准。
paras_en: As AI data centers' electricity demand continues to climb, U.S. power companies are moving to restart three shut‑down nuclear reactors, adding about 2.25 GW (2.250 million kW) of capacity, with operations slated to resume between 2027 and 2029. The Three Mile Island project is backed by a 20‑year power‑purchase agreement with Microsoft (MSFT‑US), while the Duane Arnold project is being driven by NextEra Energy (NEE‑US) in partnership with Google.

Technology outlet Tom's Hardware reports that the three restart projects are located at the Palisades nuclear plant in Michigan, the Crane Clean Energy Center at Three Mile Island in Pennsylvania, and the Duane Arnold Energy Center in Iowa. As the tech sector accelerates AI infrastructure expansion, reliable power supply and grid‑connection capacity have become critical bottlenecks, bringing previously mothballed nuclear units back into focus.

The Palisades plant is the furthest along. The report says fuel loading was completed in August 2026, and the plant is expected to resume generation around March 2027, delivering roughly 800 MW (0.800 million kW). The plant had entered decommissioning, so a successful restart would set a precedent for reactors returning to service after decommissioning has begun.
Holtec Palisades, which is handling the project, has secured a loan from the U.S. Department of Energy, with financing stemming from the Biden administration’s 2024 nuclear‑investment initiative.

The Three Mile Island restart is led by Constellation Energy (CEG‑US), which will bring Unit 1 back online under the Crane Clean Energy Center name. Although Three Mile Island suffered a nuclear accident in 1979, that involved Unit 2; the current effort targets Unit 1, which was shut down in 2019.

Constellation launched the plan in 2024, announcing a $1.6 billion investment and securing a $1 billion loan from the Department of Energy in 2025. Microsoft has signed a 20‑year power‑purchase agreement, becoming the project's primary customer.

Unit 1 is slated to restart in 2027 with a capacity of about 835 MW (0.835 million kW). Current work focuses on equipment repair and refurbishment of Unit 1, and the plant must obtain approval from the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission before fuel loading.

The third project involves NextEra Energy working with Google’s parent Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) to restart the Duane Arnold Energy Center in Iowa, which is expected to provide roughly 615 MW (0.615 million kW) of power by 2029.
NextEra Energy CEO John Ketchum said the company is pleased with the agreement with Google and emphasized that the associated costs will not be passed on to Iowa residential electricity customers.

The report notes that the reactors were previously shut down mainly due to operating costs and economic viability. Labor and maintenance expenses have pressured nuclear power against competing generation sources, but the rapid expansion of AI data centers is reshaping supply‑demand dynamics and investment conditions in the power market.

As grid connection becomes a key bottleneck for data‑center expansion, the tech sector’s need for reliable electricity creates new commercial incentives for nuclear restarts. However, whether these projects can deliver power on schedule will still depend on construction progress and regulatory approvals.

The weighted index opened higher and stayed higher, closing up 594.84 points at 46,887.77 with a turnover of NT$833.191 billion.

Observing the three major institutional investors' net positions today: foreign investors net bought NT$9.60 billion, investment trusts net bought NT$129.19 billion, proprietary traders net sold NT$133.10 billion, for a combined net purchase of NT$5.68 billion. Foreign investors switched from selling to buying, proprietary traders have been selling for ten consecutive days, while investment trusts have been buying for nine straight days, totaling a net purchase of NT$146.134 billion.

U.S. stocks on Tuesday were mixed. Corporate earnings beat expectations and falling international oil prices boosted market confidence, partially offsetting concerns about AI capital‑expenditure payback. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 529.85 points, the S&P 500 edged higher, the Nasdaq was essentially flat, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index slipped about 0.2%. On the equity side, 3M (MMM‑US) posted earnings above market forecasts and raised its full‑year outlook, sending the stock up more than 5.78%. Northrop Grumman (NOC‑US) benefited from strong aerospace and defense performance, gaining 4.57%. West Texas crude futures fell 1.8%, easing market pressure. However, doubts remain about AI infrastructure spending – Anthropic may spend up to $750 billion on new compute over the next few years – and some tech stocks faced selling pressure. Netflix (NFLX‑US) cut its ad‑revenue forecast to about $2.7 billion, dropping 1.66% after hours, keeping tech stocks divided. SpaceX (SPCX‑US) reported Q3 revenue of $14.575 billion, up 161% YoY, supporting its share price around the recent low of about $140. Super Micro Computer (SMCI‑US) also drew attention after hours, providing thematic support for the AI server segment. Overall, U.S. corporate earnings offered some support, but AI investment returns, tech valuations and capital flows remain key short‑term market drivers.

In Taiwan, the market was buoyed by the positive U.S. earnings and after‑hours strength in SpaceX and Super Micro, prompting a return of buying in AI‑related stocks. The weighted index opened high, rose, then narrowed its gains, finishing up 594.84 points at 46,887.77 with a turnover of NT$833.191 billion. After several days of pull‑backs, the market showed a rebound pattern, aided by foreign investors turning to net buying and a supportive seasonal trend line. The lower seasonal line held, suggesting future upside from lower‑value offsets. On the fundamentals side, Taiwan’s September export orders reached $114.2 billion, up 62% YoY for the 20th consecutive month, with the full‑year outlook poised to break the trillion‑dollar mark, reflecting continued demand from AI, high‑performance computing and electronics. Looking ahead, the index may find short‑term support near the seasonal line, with the possibility of a down‑then‑up oscillation. Investors should watch Nvidia’s Berlin GTC and Meta’s earnings for further AI supply‑chain momentum. During this volatility, the recommendation is to focus on stock selection rather than market timing, prioritising companies with strong revenue growth, profit improvement and visible order pipelines, while staying mindful of topping‑out risks and capital management.

Among the heavyweight stocks, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (2330‑TW) rose 0.62% to NT$2,420. At its Q3 earnings briefing, the company raised its full‑year 2026 USD revenue growth outlook from just over 40% to about 44%, marking the third upward revision this year. Chairman Mark Liu said the proliferation of agent‑based AI and open‑source models continues to drive demand for AI accelerators, CPUs and networking chips, keeping confidence in long‑term AI growth. On the process side, 2‑nm volume production began in Q4 2025, and 2027 capacity is expected to more than double. Strong 3‑nm demand will lead to a new fab in Tainan, slated for mass production in the first half of 2028. Q3 revenue hit NT$1.4942 trillion, up 50.9% YoY, with net profit of NT$763.1 billion, up 68.7% YoY, and EPS of NT$29.43. Q4 revenue is projected at $52.3‑$54.3 billion, and full‑year capex remains at $60‑$64 billion, underscoring AI demand and advanced processes as core long‑term growth engines.

Hon Hai Precision Industry (2317‑TW) climbed 3.52% to NT$250 after reaching an agreement with Japan’s Mitsubishi Electric to jointly operate the automotive components subsidiary Mitsubishi Electric Mobility (MEM). Hon Hai will acquire a 50% stake, and both parties aim to lift MEM’s revenue to ¥1 trillion by 2030, about a 22% increase from the ¥820 billion forecast for 2026. The partnership will combine Mitsubishi’s electronic control and software expertise with Hon Hai’s rapid R&D capabilities, strengthening EV software and related product offerings. If the joint venture progresses smoothly, an IPO for MEM could be considered, deepening Hon Hai’s global EV market footprint.

MediaTek (2454‑TW) slipped 0.24% to NT$4,140. Its ASIC business continues to expand, with rumors of a collaboration with ByteDance to develop AI chips. The partnership is expected to start in 2027, with tape‑out in 2028 and mass production contributing revenue in 2029. If annual demand reaches one million units, revenue could add $20‑$25 billion. MediaTek also hopes to enter Samsung’s high‑end flagship smartphone chip supply chain, boosting its mobile segment despite higher memory costs suppressing demand. New ASIC projects and higher market share in premium phones should provide momentum, and after a recent pull‑back the downside risk appears limited.

With AI compute demand climbing, semiconductor materials and high‑speed optical communications are drawing market focus. Nanya (1303‑TW) is actively securing opportunities in electronic materials and high‑end applications, while Yujingguang (3406‑TW) has partnered with global leader 3M to develop expanded‑beam optics (EBO) technology, entering the CPO and AI data‑center optical interconnect supply chain. Both firms are tapping AI industry trends from material upgrades and precision optics, making revenue growth, product rollout progress and mass‑production efficiency key performance indicators to watch.

Coupled with expanding AI material demand and vertical integration advantages, Nanya Plastics’ outlook is worth watching, especially the rollout of high‑end CCL, capacity‑expansion benefits and changes in investment‑income contributions.

Moreover, 3M intends to subscribe for about NT$4.813 billion of Yujingguang’s private‑placement ordinary shares, acquiring roughly a 4.68% stake and deepening cooperation. Yujingguang posted NT$2.672 billion revenue in September 2026, with the first three quarters totaling NT$19.636 billion, up 10.1% YoY. Future focus should be on optical‑communication product certifications and the mass‑production schedule for 2027‑2028.

items.title: 營收創新高卻迎利潤考驗 寧德時代回應產業需求與供應鏈變局
items.title_en: Revenue Hits Record High Yet Faces Profit Test: CATL Responds to Industry Demand and Supply Chain Shifts
paras: 全球電池巨頭寧德時代(300750-CN)周二(20日)盤後公布2026年第三季財報，呈現「營收擴張、利潤承壓」的兩極化格局。
數據顯示，單季營收達1,652億元人民幣，年增近59%，電池總出貨量突破260GWh；然而，單季母公司業主淨利(歸母淨利)為212.46億元，較上季(環比)下滑約5.8%，毛利率降至20.69%，單位淨利潤更跌至每度電(kWh)82元人民幣的歷史低點。在業績低於買方預期及市場對需求擔憂的夾擊下，寧德時代股價相較年內高點已回撤高達50%，單日跌幅一度衝破10%。
面對市場對電動車及儲能需求走弱的疑慮，寧德時代管理層於業績說明會上力主樂觀看待前景。管理層預估，明年全球動力及儲能電池需求仍將年增20%至30%，並直言這是「可達到且不算高」的預期。
管理層強調，全球市場需求並不如預期悲觀，中國大陸國內乘用車與商用車的電動化率正加速提升，單車帶電量顯著增加；歐洲市場持續推出有競爭力的新車型，而海外儲能需求則極為旺盛。
在產能利用率方面，管理層回應指出，今年上半年產能利用率高達94.86%。隨著新產能陸續投產，供應緊張情況已有所舒緩，未來產能利用率仍將保持在健全的高檔水準。
儘管出貨量依然強勁，各大外資投行仍普遍下修寧德時代的獲利預期。高盛分析師指出，第三季單位純益82元/kWh低於原先預估的93元/kWh，並假設寧德時代今年將承擔全部新增消費稅，預計2027年起才能與客戶分擔成本，因而將2026至2028年的每股盈餘(EPS)預測下調4%至7%。
摩根大通特別警告，第三季財報僅反映了9月實施的2%電池消費稅單月影響，第四季將面臨完整的季度稅負衝擊。若新增稅費無法順利轉嫁給車廠客戶，短期獲利能力恐將繼續承壓。瑞銀將2026至2028年淨利預測下調11%至14%；傑富瑞補充，研發費用年增43.6%達71.4億元，加上鋰價波動帶來的庫存減值，均拉低了利潤表現。
針對第三季經營現金流淨額大幅降至14.09億元人民幣的現象，寧德時代管理層澄清，這是公司主動對供應鏈發起的支持措施。為了協助受資金約束的上游核心供應商準備物料與產能，公司選擇縮短帳期並支付預付款，預計相關營運資金調整將持續兩至三個季度。
paras_en: Global battery giant CATL (300750-CN) announced its Q3 2026 earnings after the market closed on Tuesday (the 20th), showing a polarized picture of "revenue expansion but profit pressure."

The data shows quarterly revenue reached RMB 165.2 billion, up nearly 59% year‑on‑year, with total battery shipments breaking 260 GWh; however, the parent‑company net profit for the quarter was RMB 21.246 billion, down about 5.8% from the previous quarter, gross margin fell to 20.69%, and net profit per kilowatt‑hour slipped to a historic low of RMB 82. In the face of earnings below buyer expectations and market concerns over demand, CATL’s share price has fallen as much as 50% from its intra‑year high, with a single‑day drop at one point breaching 10%.

Facing doubts about weakening EV and storage‑energy demand, CATL’s management took an optimistic tone at the earnings briefing. The team forecasts global power‑train and storage battery demand will still grow 20%‑30% next year and says that outlook is "achievable and not overly high."

Management stressed that global market demand is not as bleak as feared; the electrification rate of passenger and commercial vehicles in mainland China is accelerating, raising the energy per vehicle, Europe continues to launch competitive new models, and overseas storage‑energy demand remains very strong.

Regarding capacity utilisation, management noted that the first half of the year saw utilisation as high as 94.86%. With new capacity coming online, supply tightness has eased, and utilisation is expected to stay at a healthy high level going forward.

Even though shipments remain robust, major foreign banks are broadly cutting CATL’s profit forecasts. Goldman Sachs analysts pointed out that the Q3 unit net profit of RMB 82/kWh was below the previously expected RMB 93/kWh and assumed CATL would bear the entire new consumption tax this year, projecting that cost sharing with customers would only begin in 2027, prompting a 4%‑7% downgrade to EPS estimates for 2026‑2028.

JPMorgan warned that the Q3 results only reflect the one‑month impact of the 2% battery consumption tax introduced in September, and that Q4 will face the full quarterly tax burden. If the additional tax cannot be passed on to automakers, short‑term profitability could remain under pressure. UBS cut its 2026‑2028 net‑profit forecasts by 11%‑14%; Jefferies added that R&D spending rose 43.6% year‑on‑year to RMB 7.14 billion, and inventory write‑downs from lithium‑price volatility also dragged down profit performance.

Addressing the sharp drop in Q3 operating cash‑flow net amount to RMB 1.409 billion, CATL’s management clarified that this reflects a proactive support measure for the supply chain. To help upstream core suppliers constrained by cash, the company shortened payment terms and made pre‑payments, with the related working‑capital adjustments expected to continue for two to three quarters.

items.title: AI產業出口暢旺 三三會示警：傳產仍辛苦、台灣應融入全球供應鏈
items.title_en: AI Industry Exports Surge; 33 Association Warns Traditional Sectors Still Struggle, Taiwan Should Integrate into Global Supply Chains
paras: 據財政部公布上(9)月進出口統計，在AI熱潮帶動下，單月出口年增率超過60%，出口呈現「連35紅」，締造史上最長成長期，三三會理事長林伯豐今(21)日受訪時表示，台灣整體景氣偏正面，製造、軍工與科技業發展，皆有正面的實力與發展空間，但傳產仍辛苦，台灣不應只依賴美國，要思考如何融入全球供應鏈。
三三企業交流會今(21)日舉行10月份例會，以「AI新趨勢與企業AI轉型」邀集Google台灣區前董事總經理簡立峰演講。
據統計，台灣9月外銷訂單為1,142.1億美元，前3季接單高達8,192億美元，也提早刷新全年度新高，呈現AI強勁需求帶動台灣經濟的蓬勃發展，面對台灣如何維持競爭優勢，成為產業界關注焦點。
對此，林伯豐受訪時表示，目前台灣在製造業、軍工與科技發展上一向有實力，也有發展空間，對整體景氣看法正面，台灣過去累積的製造與科技實力，是繼續發展的重大基礎，當產業擴大投資，能否找到足夠且適合的人力，也成為維持競爭力的重要環節。
對經濟部公告出口訂單持續暢旺，林伯豐表示，主要受惠AI相關需求強勁、出口暢旺，半導體與伺服器等供應鏈持續擴大投資，但部分傳統製造業目前經營相當辛苦，在人才培育與引進上仍需要努力，政府在評估整體經濟發展時，也應兼顧不同產業的實際處境。
此外，美國近期即將舉行期中選舉，林伯豐認為，台灣應關注期中選舉後的變化，也呼籲台灣企業在因應全球產業變局時，切忌將全球供應鏈的發展過度寄託於美國，而應以台灣立場為主，思考如何融入全球供應鏈。
針對台灣缺電問題上，林伯豐也重申，企業投資必須考慮供電能力、穩定性與電價，多項條件都會影響後續生產與營運安排，他也再次表達支持核電應迅速重啟的立場，並以日本經歷核災後，仍持續發展核電為例，主張台灣應重新思考能源選擇。
paras_en: According to the Ministry of Finance’s September import‑export statistics, the AI boom drove a month‑over‑month export growth rate of over 60%, delivering a "35‑month streak of red" and setting the longest growth period on record. In an interview on the 21st, 33 Association chairman Lin Bo‑feng said Taiwan’s overall economic outlook is relatively positive, with manufacturing, defense and technology sectors having solid strength and development potential, but traditional industries remain hard‑pressed. Taiwan should not rely solely on the United States and must consider how to embed itself in the global supply chain.

The 33 Enterprise Exchange Association held its October regular meeting on the 21st, inviting former Google Taiwan regional CEO Jian Li‑feng to speak on “New AI Trends and Corporate AI Transformation.”

Statistics show Taiwan’s September export orders amounted to US$114.21 billion, and total orders for the first three quarters reached US$819.2 billion, already breaking the projected annual high. The strong AI‑driven demand is fueling robust economic growth, and how Taiwan can maintain its competitive edge has become a focal point for industry leaders.

In the interview, Lin Bo‑feng emphasized that Taiwan has long possessed strength and room for growth in manufacturing, defense and technology, and he holds a positive view of the overall economy. The manufacturing and tech capabilities accumulated over the years form a major foundation for continued development, and as industries expand investment, securing sufficient and suitable talent will be a key factor in sustaining competitiveness.

Regarding the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ announcement that export orders remain robust, Lin attributed the trend mainly to strong AI‑related demand and vigorous exports, with semiconductor and server supply chains continuing to expand investment. However, some traditional manufacturers are currently struggling, and talent cultivation and recruitment still require effort. He urged the government, when assessing overall economic development, to also consider the real conditions of different sectors.

He also noted that the United States will soon hold its mid‑term elections, and Taiwan should monitor post‑election changes. Lin cautioned Taiwanese firms not to overly hinge the development of the global supply chain on the United States, but to prioritize Taiwan’s own position and think about how to integrate into the worldwide supply network.

Addressing Taiwan’s power shortage, Lin reiterated that corporate investment must take into account electricity capacity, reliability and pricing, as these factors affect production and operational planning. He reiterated his support for a swift restart of nuclear power, citing Japan’s continued nuclear development after its nuclear disaster as an example, and argued that Taiwan should re‑evaluate its energy choices.

items.title: 〈力積電法說〉Q4營收估季增雙位數 明年成熟製程代工價格再漲10-20%
items.title_en: Powerchip Semiconductor Q4 Revenue Expected Double‑Digit Quarterly Growth; Mature‑Process Foundry Prices to Rise 10‑20% Next Year
paras: 力積電(6770-TW)今(21)日召開法說，經營團隊表示，受惠記憶體供需持續吃緊、邏輯晶圓代工價格調漲，以及3D AI Foundry相關產品逐步恢復出貨，預期第四季營收可望季增雙位數；明年在AI需求動能不減下，對營收及獲利表現抱持期待，成熟製程代工價格規劃再調漲10%至20%，並積極與客戶協商長期供貨合約(LTA)，提前綁定明年價量。
力積電指出，全球DRAM市場仍處於供需失衡狀態，AI伺服器採用的高頻寬記憶體(HBM)持續消耗大廠先進製程產能，加上記憶體大廠逐步退出利基型DRAM市場，帶動相關代工需求及價格維持高檔。與美光合作的DRAM 1P製程進展順利，初版製程設計套件(PDK)預計年底前完成，相關機台將於2027年第一季前到位，第二季進入試產。
NAND Flash方面，隨三星、鎧俠逐步退出MLC NAND供應，市場短缺促使部分工控及消費電子廠商轉向SLC NAND，力積電已將SLC NAND代工平台轉向更具競爭力的24奈米製程，並與客戶合作開發MLC NAND產品，預計2026年底進入新產品NTO階段。此外，AI伺服器帶動大容量NOR Flash需求，目前市場供不應求，力積電也可望受惠相關代工需求。
邏輯代工方面，第三季8吋及12吋晶圓代工產能持續吃緊，針對非年度綁約客戶，部分投片價格較第二季調高10%至15%，平均價格調漲約8%至10%。公司指出，下半年晶圓廠產能普遍滿載，成熟製程2026年代工價格已全面調漲，2027年則規劃再漲10%至20%，目前正與客戶協商LTA及明年價量安排。
在AI相關應用方面，力積電的電源管理IC代工已由0.15微米製程切入55奈米BCD製程，相關產品應用於AI伺服器並開始放量，客戶要求簽訂三年長約以確保供貨；MOSFET及IGBT需求也持續吃緊，2027年近80%產能已與客戶簽訂LTA。
3D AI Foundry則是力積電另一項成長布局。公司表示，受銅鑼廠設備大規模停線移機影響，第三季晶圓對晶圓堆疊(WoW)及Interposer產出明顯下滑，相關營收同步減少。隨產線陸續移至新竹廠區並復線，加上積體被動元件(IPD)逐步放量，預期第四季起營收將逐漸恢復，2027年可望逐季上揚。
其中，Interposer預計年底回到滿載投片水位，WoW目前已小量投片試產，預計2027年上半年正式量產；IPD則因AI伺服器功耗提升，需求能見度已延伸至2028年，力積電明年將導入電容密度4500nF新品，應用涵蓋AI伺服器及光通訊模組。至於與美光合作的PWF，預計2026年底前完成試產線設置，2027年第四季進入量產，並可望於2028年成為3D AI Foundry新的成長動能。
力積電指出，由於無塵室空間已用盡，公司已針對台灣、新加坡及日本等地展開新廠調研，聚焦3D AI Foundry產能擴張，並與策略客戶評估共同投資的可行性，為2028年後的市場成長預作準備。
paras_en: Powerchip Semiconductor (6770‑TW) held a briefing today (21st). The management said that, benefiting from continued tight memory supply‑demand, higher logic wafer foundry prices, and the gradual recovery of shipments of 3D AI Foundry products, Q4 revenue is expected to grow double‑digit quarter‑over‑quarter. With AI demand remaining strong next year, the company is optimistic about revenue and profit, planning another 10%‑20% price increase for mature‑process foundry services and actively negotiating long‑term supply agreements (LTA) with customers to lock in next year’s price‑volume in advance.

Powerchip noted that the global DRAM market remains in a supply‑demand imbalance. High‑bandwidth memory (HBM) used in AI servers continues to consume advanced‑process capacity from major fabs, and major memory makers are gradually exiting the niche DRAM market, keeping related foundry demand and prices high. The DRAM 1‑pattern process co‑developed with Micron is progressing smoothly, with the first‑version process design kit (PDK) expected by year‑end and equipment slated to arrive before Q1 2027, entering pilot production in Q2.

Regarding NAND flash, as Samsung and Kioxia gradually withdraw MLC NAND supply, market shortages are pushing some industrial and consumer‑electronics manufacturers toward SLC NAND. Powerchip has shifted its SLC NAND foundry platform to a more competitive 24‑nm process and is co‑developing MLC NAND products with customers, targeting entry into the new‑product NTO phase by the end of 2026. In addition, AI servers are driving demand for high‑capacity NOR flash, which is currently undersupplied, and Powerchip expects to benefit from that demand as well.

In logic foundry, Q3 capacity for 8‑inch and 12‑inch wafers remained tight. For non‑annual‑contract customers, some wafer‑injection prices were raised 10%‑15% versus Q2, with an average price increase of about 8%‑10%. The company said that wafer‑fab capacity was generally fully booked in the second half of the year, mature‑process prices for the 2026 era have already been raised across the board, and a further 10%‑20% increase is planned for 2027. Negotiations on LTAs and next‑year price‑volume arrangements are ongoing.

In AI‑related applications, Powerchip’s power‑management IC foundry has moved from a 0.15‑µm process to a 55‑nm BCD process, with products used in AI servers now ramping up and customers requiring three‑year long‑term contracts to secure supply. Demand for MOSFETs and IGBTs also remains tight, with nearly 80% of 2027 capacity already covered by LTAs with customers.

The 3D AI Foundry is another growth pillar for Powerchip. The company said that large‑scale equipment shutdowns and relocations at the Guola plant caused a noticeable drop in wafer‑on‑wafer (WoW) stacking and interposer output in Q3, reducing related revenue. As production lines are gradually moved to the Hsinchu campus and re‑commissioned, and as integrated passive devices (IPD) scale up, revenue is expected to recover starting in Q4, with quarterly growth anticipated through 2027.

Interposer capacity is expected to return to full‑load wafer‑injection levels by year‑end, while WoW has entered limited pilot production and is slated for volume production in the first half of 2027. IPD demand, driven by higher power consumption in AI servers, now has visibility through 2028; Powerchip will introduce a new 4500 nF capacitor‑density product next year for AI servers and optical‑communication modules. For the Micron‑partnered PWF, pilot‑line setup is expected by the end of 2026, volume production in Q4 2027, and it could become a new growth engine for the 3D AI Foundry in 2028.

Powerchip noted that clean‑room space is already fully utilized, prompting the company to explore new factories in Taiwan, Singapore and Japan, focusing on expanding 3D AI Foundry capacity and evaluating joint‑investment opportunities with strategic customers to prepare for market growth beyond 2028.

paras_en: Powerchip Semiconductor (6770‑TW) held an earnings briefing today (21st) and released its third‑quarter unaudited financial results. Net profit after tax for Q3 was NT$6.5 billion, up 98% sequentially, with earnings per share of NT$1.38, turning to profit compared with the same period last year. Cumulatively for the first three quarters, net profit after tax was NT$24.022 billion, or NT$5.42 per share, also a turnaround from a loss year‑over‑year.

Q3 revenue reached NT$21.343 billion, up 23.4% sequentially and 80.3% year‑over‑year. Gross margin was 47.55%, a sequential increase of 19.3 percentage points. Operating margin stood at 36.69%, up 15.4 percentage points sequentially. For the first three quarters, revenue totaled NT$52.205 billion, up 52.5% year‑over‑year; gross margin was 31.46% and operating margin 49.31%, both turning from negative to positive compared with the prior year.

Powerchip explained that third‑quarter capacity utilization rose from 87% in Q2 to 97%. Wafer shipments were about 416,000 pieces, down roughly 1.4% sequentially and 5.5% year‑over‑year. The slight decline in wafer shipments was mainly due to the relocation of equipment at the Tongluo plant and capacity adjustments, but higher average selling prices and improved capacity utilization drove revenue and profit growth.

In terms of product mix by process node, the 24/25/28 nm processes accounted for 47% of sales, 0.18 µm for 17%, 30 nm and 0.11/0.14 µm each for 10%, 40/55 nm for 7%, 0.15 µm for 4%, 63/80/90 nm for 3%, and processes above 0.25 µm for 2%.

By product category, DRAM contributed 55% of sales, power‑management ICs (PMIC) 14%, discrete components 11%, flash memory and high‑voltage logic drivers each 6%, embedded logic products (IMC) 4%, 3D AI Foundry 1.4%, and image‑sensor ICs (CIS) 1%.

items.title: EPS年年成長，為何股價越跌越低？看懂好公司也會套牢你的兩個原因
items.title_en: EPS Grows Year Over Year, Yet the Stock Keeps Falling? Two Reasons Even Good Companies Can Trap You
paras: 2026年10月21日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 明明有一家公司很有競爭力，市占率也高，市場預估未來EPS會一路成長，但為何股價卻不斷下跌？這時候投資人的第一個直覺都是：是不是有一些潛在利空我不知道？
投資人只要稍微研究一下，通常都能理解公司的競爭能力，也能知道競爭對手有哪些？強不強。在稍微理解一下技術之後，也應該能確定這產品未來展望好不好，所以一定是怎麼想都想不通，才會有這疑問。
關於這件事，可以有兩個解讀方向。

#1 短期成長率會下降：與循環有關
當你確定公司競爭力沒有什麼問題，最常見的潛在利空通常營運循環有關。簡單說，市場可能懷疑目前的營收與出貨狀況會是一個高峰，之後營運會暫時回落，所以股價表現疲弱。
這種訂單與交貨的波動，是最常見的情況。尤其當之前的成長率越高，回落的幅度也越深，因為營收成長也同時代表之前有大量訂單被實現交付，需要一段時間讓公司重新累積訂單能量，才有辦法再創高峰。
即使是需求快速成長的行業也會如此，因為訂單都是一批一批出現，一批一批交貨，有時候多有時候少，這都屬於正常商業活動，不可能像便利商店一樣絡繹不絕，消費永不間斷。
這種庫存的循環波動相當正常，但確實仍會影響股價波動。

#2 長期成長率會下降，與週期有關
同樣是10元的EPS，本益比從20倍下降到15倍，也會讓股價跌掉25%。所以即使法人盈餘預測是正確的，如果遇到本益比下降的話也會讓股價下跌。
本益比下降如果是因為短期大盤動盪，未來會重新上升的話，稱為估值修正。但比較需要特別注意的是，本益比出現長期性的下降，以後本益比都不會高了，那這通常與週期有關。
一般來說，現在看到供應商的出貨成長率越高，代表終端需求正在被滿足，之後的成長率會大幅下降，在這種情況下，本益比下降就是長期性的下降。
舉例來說，AI晶片長期成長率為40%，但供應商未來幾年的出貨量卻被預估以每年以60%的速度增長，很明顯地，這種高成長率在週期過了之後會大幅下降，所以本益比會隨著出貨量增加越多而越來越低。
這其實也是正常的現象，但是被很多投資人忽略。
舉例來說，智邦(2345-TW)。這家公司被預估會成長，公司月營收也保持成長態勢，但股價仍然大幅回檔。我們先假設沒有其他潛在利空，有沒有所謂短期營運循環，來看看這家公司的成長週期。
如下圖，1815元的股價約當2026年預估本益比20倍，隨著公司EPS一路成長，到了2028年，當它的EPS成長到173.66元的時候，本益比就會剩下10倍出頭。
問題來了？你覺得市場的估值正不正確？很難講，各有說法。
但如果我們試著把成長週期的概念套用進去，就很容易理解這個估值其實沒有太大問題。因為2026~2028年之間，市場預估智邦每年會成長四成以上，很明顯地高於交換器的長期成長率，代表這段期間有絕大部分的需求被滿足，到了2028年之後，智邦的長期成長率本來就應該要大幅度下降，到時候AI交換器變得跟現在的交換器一樣很普遍之後，10倍的本益比對於硬體代工廠來說，其實並沒有太大問題。
當一家公司的本益比無法變得更高，此時，只能靠EPS成長來推升股價上漲，而EPS每年才成長一次，股價的反應自然就會比較慢，需要投資人有耐性，有時候不一定是因為公司基本面有何變化。
這種現象也出現在輝達身上，如下圖所示，輝達也交易在2028年預估EPS的10倍本益比，所以投資人需要先預判未來週期，才能提前預估到本益比會下降還升高。

paras_en: October 21, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Even when a company is highly competitive, has a large market share, and analysts expect its EPS to keep rising, why does its stock keep sliding? Investors’ first instinct is often: is there some hidden downside I don’t know about?

If investors do a little research, they can usually grasp the company’s competitive strengths, identify its rivals, and assess how strong they are. After understanding the technology a bit, they should also be able to gauge the product’s future outlook, so the lingering doubt must stem from something else.
There are two ways to interpret this situation.

#1 Short‑term growth rate may decline: related to cycles. When you are confident the company’s competitiveness is solid, the most common hidden downside is operational cycles. In simple terms, the market may suspect that current revenue and shipment levels are at a peak and that operations will temporarily pull back, leading to weak stock performance.

These order‑and‑delivery fluctuations are the most common scenario. Especially when prior growth rates were high, the subsequent pull‑back tends to be deeper, because revenue growth also means a large backlog of orders has been fulfilled, and the firm needs time to rebuild order momentum before reaching another peak again.

Even fast‑growing industries experience this, as orders arrive in batches and are shipped in batches—sometimes more, sometimes less. This is normal business activity and cannot run continuously like a convenience store with nonstop consumer traffic.
Such inventory‑cycle swings are quite normal, but they do affect stock price volatility.

#2 Long‑term growth rate may decline, tied to cycles. Even with a 10‑dollar EPS, a drop in the P/E multiple from 20× to 15× would cut the stock price by 25%. So even if analysts’ earnings forecasts are correct, a falling P/E will still push the price down.

If the P/E decline is due to short‑term market turbulence and is expected to rebound, it’s called a valuation correction. However, special attention is needed when the P/E shows a long‑term downward trend that won’t recover, which is usually cycle‑related.

Generally, when supplier shipment growth rates are high, it signals that end‑demand is being satisfied, and future growth rates will fall sharply. In such cases, a declining P/E reflects a long‑term decline.

For example, AI chips have a long‑term growth rate of 40%, but suppliers are projected to increase shipments at a 60% annual pace for the next few years. Clearly, after the cycle passes, that high growth will taper off dramatically, causing the P/E to drop as shipment volumes rise.
This is actually a normal phenomenon, but many investors overlook it.

Take ZhiBang (2345‑TW). The company is expected to grow, its monthly revenue remains on an upward trend, yet the stock has pulled back sharply. Assuming no other hidden downside, let’s examine whether a short‑term operational cycle explains its growth pattern.
In the chart, a stock price of NT$1,815 corresponds to an estimated 2026 P/E of 20×. As EPS rises, by 2028 when EPS reaches NT$173.66, the P/E would fall to just over 10×.
The question is: is the market’s valuation correct? It’s hard to say; opinions differ.

But if we apply the growth‑cycle concept, the valuation makes sense. Between 2026 and 2028, the market expects ZhiBang to grow over 40% annually, clearly above the long‑term growth rate of switches, indicating that most demand will be met in that period. After 2028, ZhiBang’s long‑term growth should drop sharply, and when AI switches become as common as today’s switches, a 10× P/E isn’t unreasonable for a hardware foundry.

When a company’s P/E can’t rise further, it must rely on EPS growth to lift the stock. Since EPS only grows once a year, the stock’s reaction is slower, requiring investor patience; it isn’t always due to a change in fundamentals.

This phenomenon also appears with Nvidia, as shown in the chart: Nvidia trades at a 10× P/E based on its projected 2028 EPS, so investors need to anticipate future cycles to forecast whether the P/E will fall or rise.

台股方面，受到美股企業財報利多及SpaceX、美超微盤後走強激勵，AI相關族群買盤回流，加權指數今日開高走高，隨後漲幅收斂，，終場上漲594.84點，收在46887.77，成交量8331.91億；台股在連日回檔後出現反彈格局，加上外資由賣轉買超之下，且下檔季線有守，未來會往低值扣抵，都有利於未來行情，加上台股基本面方面，台灣9月外銷訂單達1,142億美元，年增62%，連續20個月正成長，全年有望突破兆美元，反映AI、高效能運算及電子產業需求仍具支撐，，展望後市，指數短線有望在季線附近尋求支撐，盤勢不排除呈現先下後上的震盪格局，後續須持續觀察輝達柏林GTC大會及Meta財報表現，能否進一步帶動AI供應鏈買氣，在指數震盪之際，操作上建議維持選股不選市策略，優先聚焦營收成長、獲利改善及訂單能見度較高的個股，掌握族群輪動機會，同時留意追高風險與資金控管。

權值股方面，(2330-TW)台積電，上漲0.62%，收在2420元，第三季法說會釋出強勁展望，2026年全年美元營收成長預估由原先略高於40%上修至約44%，為今年第三度調高目標，董事長魏哲家指出，代理式AI與開源模型普及，持續推升AI加速器、CPU及網路晶片需求，對長期AI成長維持信心，製程方面，2奈米已於2025年第四季量產，預計2027年全年產能增加逾一倍，因3奈米需求強勁，台南將增建新廠，預計2028年上半年量產，財報方面，第三季營收1兆4,942億元，年增50.9%，稅後純益7,631億元，年增68.7%，每股純益29.43元，第四季營收預估523億至543億美元，全年資本支出維持600億至640億美元，顯示AI需求與先進製程仍是長期成長核心動能 ；

(2317-TW)鴻海，上漲3.52%，收在250元，與日本三菱電機達成協議，將共同經營車用零組件子公司三菱電機移動公司MEM，鴻海將取得50%股權，雙方目標於2030年度將MEM營收提升至1兆日圓，較2026年度預估的8,200億日圓成長約22%，並結合三菱電機電子控制與軟體技術，以及鴻海快速研發優勢，強化電動車軟體及相關產品布局，若合資事業發展順利，未來不排除推動MEM IPO上市，深化全球電動車市場布局；

(2454-TW)聯發科，下跌0.24%，收在4140元，ASIC業務版圖持續擴大，市場傳出與字節跳動合作開發AI晶片，預計2027年啟動合作、2028年投片，2029年量產貢獻營收，若年需求達100萬顆，營收貢獻可望達200億至250億美元，此外，聯發科有望切入三星高階旗艦手機晶片供應鏈，帶動手機業務成長，儘管記憶體成本上升壓抑手機需求，ASIC新案與高階手機市占提升可望挹注動能，近期股價回檔後，下檔風險相對有限。
隨著AI運算需求持續攀升，半導體材料與高速光通訊成為市場關注焦點，(1303-TW)南亞，積極掌握電子材料與高階應用商機，(3406-TW)玉晶光，則攜手國際大廠3M布局EBO擴束光學技術，切入CPO及AI資料中心光互連供應鏈。兩家公司分別從材料升級與精密光學切入AI產業趨勢，後續營收成長動能、產品布局進度及量產效益，將是觀察營運表現的重要指標。
2026.5.27 股市期皇后領先預告(1303-TW)南亞

南亞塑膠受惠AI伺服器及高速網通需求持續升溫，高階銅箔基板CCL出貨成長、產品組合升級與產能利用率提升，可望帶動獲利進入強勁復甦期，法人預估，2026年電子材料事業將貢獻約85%營業利益，隨M8以上高階產品放量，加上2027年起玻纖布與CCL產能擴充，毛利率仍有提升空間，此外，塑膠及化工本業逐步回溫，轉投資南亞科與台塑化的獲利貢獻改善，也有助挹注整體業績，預估2026至2028年稅後淨利將持續成長，搭配AI材料需求擴張與垂直整合優勢，南亞塑膠營運前景值得關注，後續可留意高階CCL放量進度、產能擴建效益及轉投資收益變化。
2026.8.29 股市期皇后領先預告(3406-TW)玉晶光

玉晶光攜手3M投入擴束光學技術EBO研發與量產，產品布局由精密光學鏡頭延伸至CPO及高速光互連模組，預計2026年第四季至2027年初逐步提升產能，3M也規劃透過玉晶光擴充供應能力，搶攻AI資料中心光通訊商機，此外，3M擬以約48.13億元認購玉晶光私募普通股，持股約4.68%，深化雙方合作，玉晶光2026年9月營收26.72億元，前三季營收196.36億元，年增10.1%，後續可留意光通訊產品認證及2027至2028年量產進度。

paras_en: Large-Volume Strong-Rise Stock Review: Missed Nanya (+312%) and Yujingguang (+24%)? Stop chasing higher prices – the next wave of Taiwan market rebound is the new mainstream, get ready to line up!
(Like, subscribe and turn on the notification bell)
Now let's take a look at today's Taiwan market!
The weighted index opened higher and stayed higher, closing up 594.84 points at 46,887.77 with a turnover of NT$833.191 billion.

Observing the three major institutional investors' net positions today: foreign investors net bought NT$9.60 billion, investment trusts net bought NT$129.19 billion, proprietary traders net sold NT$133.10 billion, for a combined net purchase of NT$5.68 billion. Foreign investors switched from selling to buying, proprietary traders have been selling for ten consecutive days, while investment trusts have been buying for nine straight days, totaling a net purchase of NT$146.134 billion.

U.S. stocks on Tuesday were mixed. Corporate earnings beat expectations and falling international oil prices boosted market confidence, partially offsetting concerns about AI capital‑expenditure payback. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 529.85 points, the S&P 500 edged higher, the Nasdaq was essentially flat, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index slipped about 0.2%. On the equity side, 3M (MMM‑US) posted earnings above market forecasts and raised its full‑year outlook, sending the stock up more than 5.78%. Northrop Grumman (NOC‑US) benefited from strong aerospace and defense performance, gaining 4.57%. West Texas crude futures fell 1.8%, easing market pressure. However, doubts remain about AI infrastructure spending – Anthropic may spend up to $750 billion on new compute over the next few years – and some tech stocks faced selling pressure. Netflix (NFLX‑US) cut its ad‑revenue forecast to about $2.7 billion, dropping 1.66% after hours, keeping tech stocks divided. SpaceX (SPCX‑US) reported Q3 revenue of $14.575 billion, up 161% YoY, supporting its share price around the recent low of about $140. Super Micro Computer (SMCI‑US) also drew attention after hours, providing thematic support for the AI server segment. Overall, U.S. corporate earnings offered some support, but AI investment returns, tech valuations and capital flows remain key short‑term market drivers.

In Taiwan, the market was buoyed by the positive U.S. earnings and after‑hours strength in SpaceX and Super Micro, prompting a return of buying in AI‑related stocks. The weighted index opened high, rose, then narrowed its gains, finishing up 594.84 points at 46,887.77 with a turnover of NT$833.191 billion. After several days of pull‑backs, the market showed a rebound pattern, aided by foreign investors turning to net buying and a supportive seasonal trend line. The lower seasonal line held, suggesting future upside from lower‑value offsets. On the fundamentals side, Taiwan’s September export orders reached $114.2 billion, up 62% YoY for the 20th consecutive month, with the full‑year outlook poised to break the trillion‑dollar mark, reflecting continued demand from AI, high‑performance computing and electronics. Looking ahead, the index may find short‑term support near the seasonal line, with the possibility of a down‑then‑up oscillation. Investors should watch Nvidia’s Berlin GTC and Meta’s earnings for further AI supply‑chain momentum. During this volatility, the recommendation is to focus on stock selection rather than market timing, prioritising companies with strong revenue growth, profit improvement and visible order pipelines, while staying mindful of topping‑out risks and capital management.

Among the heavyweight stocks, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (2330‑TW) rose 0.62% to NT$2,420. At its Q3 earnings briefing, the company raised its full‑year 2026 USD revenue growth outlook from just over 40% to about 44%, marking the third upward revision this year. Chairman Mark Liu said the proliferation of agent‑based AI and open‑source models continues to drive demand for AI accelerators, CPUs and networking chips, keeping confidence in long‑term AI growth. On the process side, 2‑nm volume production began in Q4 2025, and 2027 capacity is expected to more than double. Strong 3‑nm demand will lead to a new fab in Tainan, slated for mass production in the first half of 2028. Q3 revenue hit NT$1.4942 trillion, up 50.9% YoY, with net profit of NT$763.1 billion, up 68.7% YoY, and EPS of NT$29.43. Q4 revenue is projected at $52.3‑$54.3 billion, and full‑year capex remains at $60‑$64 billion, underscoring AI demand and advanced processes as core long‑term growth engines.

Hon Hai Precision Industry (2317‑TW) climbed 3.52% to NT$250 after reaching an agreement with Japan’s Mitsubishi Electric to jointly operate the automotive components subsidiary Mitsubishi Electric Mobility (MEM). Hon Hai will acquire a 50% stake, and both parties aim to lift MEM’s revenue to ¥1 trillion by 2030, about a 22% increase from the ¥820 billion forecast for 2026. The partnership will combine Mitsubishi’s electronic control and software expertise with Hon Hai’s rapid R&D capabilities, strengthening EV software and related product offerings. If the joint venture progresses smoothly, an IPO for MEM could be considered, deepening Hon Hai’s global EV market footprint.

MediaTek (2454‑TW) slipped 0.24% to NT$4,140. Its ASIC business continues to expand, with rumors of a collaboration with ByteDance to develop AI chips. The partnership is expected to start in 2027, with tape‑out in 2028 and mass production contributing revenue in 2029. If annual demand reaches one million units, revenue could add $20‑$25 billion. MediaTek also hopes to enter Samsung’s high‑end flagship smartphone chip supply chain, boosting its mobile segment despite higher memory costs suppressing demand. New ASIC projects and higher market share in premium phones should provide momentum, and after a recent pull‑back the downside risk appears limited.

With AI compute demand climbing, semiconductor materials and high‑speed optical communications are drawing market focus. Nanya (1303‑TW) is actively securing opportunities in electronic materials and high‑end applications, while Yujingguang (3406‑TW) has partnered with global leader 3M to develop expanded‑beam optics (EBO) technology, entering the CPO and AI data‑center optical interconnect supply chain. Both firms are tapping AI industry trends from material upgrades and precision optics, making revenue growth, product rollout progress and mass‑production efficiency key performance indicators to watch.
May 27, 2026 – Stock Futures Queen’s Early Forecast for Nanya (1303‑TW)
Nanya (1303‑TW): price target moves from 79 to 325.5, an early‑forecast gain of +312%.

Nanya Plastics benefits from rising AI server and high‑speed networking demand. Higher‑grade copper‑clad laminate (CCL) shipments are growing, product mix is upgrading and capacity utilisation is improving, which should drive a strong profit recovery. Analysts estimate that in 2026 the electronic‑materials segment will contribute about 85% of operating profit. With M8‑and‑above high‑end products scaling up and the expansion of glass‑fiber cloth and CCL capacity from 2027, gross margins have room to improve. Additionally, the plastics and chemicals core business is warming up, and earnings from investments in Nanya Technology and Formosa Plastics Chemical are improving, supporting overall performance. Net profit after tax is projected to keep rising from 2026 to 2028. Coupled with expanding AI material demand and vertical integration advantages, Nanya Plastics’ outlook is worth watching, especially the rollout of high‑end CCL, capacity‑expansion benefits and changes in investment‑income contributions.
August 29, 2026 – Stock Futures Queen’s Early Forecast for Yujingguang (3406‑TW)
Yujingguang (3406‑TW): price target moves from 917 to 1,140, an early‑forecast gain of +24%.

Yujingguang, together with 3M, is investing in EBO expanded‑beam optics R&D and mass production. Its product portfolio extends from precision optical lenses to CPO and high‑speed optical interconnect modules. Capacity is expected to ramp up gradually from Q4 2026 into early 2027, and 3M plans to use Yujingguang’s expanded supply capability to capture AI data‑center optical‑communication opportunities. Moreover, 3M intends to subscribe for about NT$4.813 billion of Yujingguang’s private‑placement ordinary shares, acquiring roughly a 4.68% stake and deepening cooperation. Yujingguang posted NT$2.672 billion revenue in September 2026, with the first three quarters totaling NT$19.636 billion, up 10.1% YoY. Future focus should be on optical‑communication product certifications and the mass‑production schedule for 2027‑2028.

paras: 在AI及儲能市場需求持續強勁帶動下，繼電器廠松川精密(7788-TW)營運持續成長。松川精密董事會今(21)日決議，擬以發行總額上限15億元的無擔保可轉換公司債(CB)進行籌資，這也是公司自2025年10月16日上市掛牌以來，首度透過資本市場籌資，本次發行主辦券商為元大證券。
松川精密營運持續大幅成長，2026年前9月營收68.52億元，已超越2025年全年營收總和，年增幅達44%。公司並指出，此一市場籌資用途償還銀行借款及充實營運資金。
松川精密9月營收以8.77億元改寫歷史次高，年增73.3%，推升第三季營收再以27.35億元創新高，成為連續4個季度營收創新高的強勁營運走勢，展望第四季營收，法人估將持平於第三季，但仍有再登頂契機。
松川精密2026年7 月營收首見突破 9 億元、達 9.86 億元創新高，月增 19.09%，年增 99.38%，8月及9月營收陸續改寫歷史次高。松川 7 月稅後純益1.22億元，年增1.96倍，單月毛利率也績站穩30%以上，每股稅後賺進1.53元；加計上半年財報，2026年前7月稅後純益5.93億元，每股純益達7.05元。
統一投顧最新報告指出，以松川精密2027年每股純益20元為評價基礎，維持25倍本益比，目標價維持500元，投資評等維持「強力買進」。

統一投顧指出，受船期遞延影響，松川精密第三季營收27.36億元，第四季再受AI電源5.5kW轉8.5kW平台世代交替影響，客戶拉貨短期放緩，統一投顧展望2027年，儲能隨新一代5MW機櫃導入加速成長，電動車高壓平台升級與國際車廠轉單延續，AI電源則在8.5kW新平台與HVDC接棒下占比升至20%，三大終端的高壓化同步進入放量階段，繼電器規格與單價逐步升級。研究部預估松川2026、2027年每股純益分別為13.85元及20.03元，隨終端持續高壓化，繼電器由低價零組件轉為不可或缺的安全隔離元件，松川憑高壓專利技術與專注本業的開發速度，在國際大廠退出之際持續承接轉單並擴大市占。

paras_en: Amid sustained strong demand in AI and energy‑storage markets, relay maker Matsukawa Precision (7788‑TW) continues to grow its operations. The board resolved today (the 21st) to raise funds by issuing unsecured convertible bonds (CB) with a total amount up to NT$15 billion, marking the company’s first capital‑market financing since its listing on October 16, 2025. The lead underwriter is Yuanta Securities.

Matsukawa’s operations keep expanding rapidly, with revenue of NT$6.852 billion for the first nine months of 2026, already surpassing the full‑year revenue of 2025 and representing a 44% year‑over‑year increase. The company said the proceeds will be used to repay bank loans and bolster working capital.

Revenue in September reached NT$877 million, a historic second‑high, up 73.3% year‑over‑year, pushing third‑quarter revenue to a new high of NT$2.735 billion – the fourth consecutive quarter of record revenue. Analysts expect fourth‑quarter revenue to be flat versus Q3, but still see upside potential.

In July 2026, revenue broke the NT$900 million barrier at NT$986 million, up 19.09% month‑over‑month and 99.38% year‑over‑year, with August and September also posting historic second‑highs. July net profit after tax was NT$122 million, a 1.96‑fold annual increase, with monthly gross margin staying above 30% and earnings per share of NT$1.53. Including the first seven months of the year, net profit after tax reached NT$593 million, or NT$7.05 per share.

Unified Investment Research’s latest report values Matsukawa at NT$20 earnings per share for 2027, applies a 25‑times price‑earnings multiple, and keeps the target price at NT$500 with a “Strong Buy” rating.

Unified notes that delayed vessel schedules caused Q3 revenue of NT$2.736 billion, and that Q4 will see a short‑term slowdown as customers adjust to the transition from 5.5 kW to 8.5 kW AI‑power platforms. Looking to 2027, storage growth will accelerate with new‑generation 5 MW cabinets, EV high‑voltage platform upgrades and international OEM order shifts will continue, and AI power will rise to 20% share on the new 8.5 kW platform and HVDC hand‑over. The research team forecasts EPS of NT$13.85 for 2026 and NT$20.03 for 2027, expecting relay specifications and prices to rise as end‑markets move to higher voltages, turning relays from low‑cost components into essential safety isolation parts. Leveraging high‑voltage patents and rapid product development, Matsukawa is poised to capture orders from exiting global players and expand market share.

Matsukawa’s high‑voltage, high‑current products for data‑center (CSP) inverters, server power supplies and UPS systems have begun scaling noticeably since the second half of 2025. This has not only driven rapid revenue growth and new records, but also increased the share of these products from 12% a year ago to 17% today – a five‑percentage‑point rise with clear upward momentum.

Revenue has set new historic highs for four consecutive quarters. Shipping value for data‑center inverters, server power supplies and UPS high‑voltage products grew to NT$700 million in the first half of 2026, representing 17% of revenue, up from NT$388 million in the same period of 2025 – an 80% increase.

Because demand for AI servers and related applications is soaring, Matsukawa is accelerating new‑capacity investments, planning to spend over NT$400 million this year on new facilities in Mexico and Vietnam. The Mexico plant’s budget does not yet cover the capacity needed for major power‑supply customers after their expansions, and Matsukawa says it is closely monitoring these customers’ production schedules and demand trends.

Matsukawa completed expansions of its Chiayi, Taiwan plant and its Vietnam alliance plant early in 2026 and is now adding capacity in Mexico and Vietnam. This year’s capital plan has been raised to over NT$400 million. To further integrate into Taiwan’s power‑supply ecosystem, the company will expand the Mexico plant – which still has 50% unused capacity – in line with key customer needs and production timelines.

Major global cloud service providers continue to increase capex, and the AI race is turning into an arms race. Taiwan’s Lite‑On (2301‑TW) and Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) are each planning US$40‑50 billion of capital spending to acquire land and expand power‑supply capacity in Texas, USA.

二、籌碼與資金面：ETF及內資動向成為重要支撐

近期外資大幅賣超引發市場疑慮，但不能單憑賣超金額就判定多頭行情反轉，仍須觀察新台幣匯率、外資賣壓是否收斂，以及權值股能否止穩。

三、基本面：AI長線需求仍是台股重要支柱

台灣9月外銷訂單達1,142.1億美元，年增62.4%，續創單月歷史新高，反映AI、高效能運算及雲端服務需求依然強勁；後續應追蹤10月接單表現及全年外銷訂單能否突破兆美元。
台積電(2330-TW)在先進製程與晶片製造的競爭優勢，仍是台股中長期的重要支撐；若從獲利成長的角度觀察，市場預估2028年每股稅後純益(EPS)可望達到200元，若以本益比20倍估算，股價便可達4,000元水準，反映市場對AI長期成長及台積電獲利能力的期待，推升指數持續往5.5萬、甚至6萬點大關推進。惟市場對2028年EPS及股價的推估屬於預測情境，仍須留意實際獲利、估值與產業競爭變化。
美國科技股進入財報密集公布期，AI相關企業的營收成長、獲利能力及資本支出回報，將影響市場對AI產業的評價。CoreWeave股債波動所反映的融資風險，也提醒投資人不能忽略企業財務體質。


四、產業與個股：聚焦AI供應鏈及材料升級

PCB／CCL與電子材料： AI伺服器、高速傳輸及先進封裝推動材料規格升級，具備高階產品、技術門檻及客戶認證優勢的廠商值得追蹤。
玻璃基板與先進封裝： 隨面板級封裝及高階載板技術發展，玻璃核心材料的平坦度、剛性及低熱膨脹係數優勢，成為值得關注的技術方向，但量產進度與商業化效益仍須驗證。
CPO矽光子、被動元件與自動化設備： 受惠高速傳輸、AI電源需求及先進封裝設備投資，相關族群有機會持續輪動；惟個股仍須回歸訂單、營收、獲利及估值判斷。
特化材料與低基期轉機股： 台積電先進製程投資可望帶動相關材料需求，但轉型成果與獲利貢獻存在時間差，不宜僅憑題材追價。


五、技術面與操作策略：反彈不等於反轉，選股重於選市

短線先觀察44,210～45,169點支撐區，以及10日線、月線能否有效收復；若反彈無量、均線壓力未解，仍須防範震盪與再次回測。
