items.title: AI 搶電催動核電復活 美國重啟3座反應爐
items.title_en: AI Power Demand Drives Nuclear Power Revival, US Restarts Three Reactors
paras: AI 資料中心用電需求持續攀升之際，美國電力業者正推動重啟 3 座已停機的核反應爐，合計發電容量約 2.25 GW (225 萬瓩)，預計於 2027 年至 2029 年陸續恢復運轉。其中，三哩島計畫獲微軟 (MSFT-US) 20 年購電合約支持，Duane Arnold 計畫則由 NextEra Energy (NEE-US) 與 Google 合作推動。
科技媒體《Tom's Hardware》報導，這 3 項重啟計畫分別位於密西根州的 Palisades 核電廠、賓州三哩島的 Crane 清潔能源中心，以及愛荷華州的 Duane Arnold 能源中心。隨著科技業加速擴建 AI 基礎設施，穩定電力供應與電網接入能力成為重要瓶頸，也讓先前因經濟因素停機的核電機組重新受到關注。
其中，Palisades 核電廠重啟進度最快。報導指出，該廠已於 2026 年 8 月裝填燃料，預計在 2027 年 3 月前後恢復發電，提供約 800 MW (80 萬瓩) 電力。這座電廠先前已進入除役作業，若成功重啟，將成為核反應爐開始除役後恢復運轉的重要先例。
負責該計畫的 Holtec Palisades 已獲美國能源部貸款支持，相關融資源自拜登政府於 2024 年推動的核能投資措施。
賓州三哩島的重啟計畫則由 Constellation Energy (CEG-US) 主導，將恢復 1 號機組運轉，並以 Crane 清潔能源中心之名營運。三哩島曾於 1979 年發生核事故，但當時出事的是 2 號機組，本次重啟對象則是 2019 年停機的 1 號機組。
Constellation 於 2024 年啟動計畫，當時宣布預計投入 16 億美元，並於 2025 年取得美國能源部 10 億美元貸款。微軟已簽署為期 20 年的購電合約，成為這項計畫的主要客戶。
該機組預計於 2027 年恢復運轉，發電容量約 835 MW (83.5 萬瓩)。目前工程主要針對 1 號機組進行設備修復與翻新，裝填燃料前仍須取得美國核能管理委員會 (NRC) 核准。
第三項計畫是 NextEra Energy 與 Google 母公司 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 旗下的 Google 合作，推動愛荷華州 Duane Arnold 能源中心恢復運轉，預計於 2029 年提供約 615 MW (61.5 萬瓩) 電力。
NextEra Energy 執行長 John Ketchum 表示，公司對與 Google 達成的合作協議感到滿意，並強調，相關成本不會由愛荷華州住宅用電戶負擔。
報導指出，這些機組先前停機，主要與營運成本及經濟效益有關。人力與維護支出使核電在與其他發電方式競爭時承受壓力，但 AI 資料中心快速擴張，正改變電力市場的供需與投資條件。
隨著電網接入成為資料中心擴建的重要瓶頸，科技業者取得穩定電力的需求，也為核電重啟提供新的商業誘因。不過，各項計畫能否如期供電，仍取決於工程進度與監管核准。
paras_en: As AI data centers' electricity demand continues to climb, U.S. power companies are moving to restart three shut‑down nuclear reactors, adding about 2.25 GW (2.250 million kW) of capacity, with operations slated to resume between 2027 and 2029. The Three Mile Island project is backed by a 20‑year power‑purchase agreement with Microsoft (MSFT‑US), while the Duane Arnold project is being driven by NextEra Energy (NEE‑US) in partnership with Google.

Technology outlet Tom's Hardware reports that the three restart projects are located at the Palisades nuclear plant in Michigan, the Crane Clean Energy Center at Three Mile Island in Pennsylvania, and the Duane Arnold Energy Center in Iowa. As the tech sector accelerates AI infrastructure expansion, reliable power supply and grid‑connection capacity have become critical bottlenecks, bringing previously mothballed nuclear units back into focus.

The Palisades plant is the furthest along. The report says fuel loading was completed in August 2026, and the plant is expected to resume generation around March 2027, delivering roughly 800 MW (0.800 million kW). The plant had entered decommissioning, so a successful restart would set a precedent for reactors returning to service after decommissioning has begun.
Holtec Palisades, which is handling the project, has secured a loan from the U.S. Department of Energy, with financing stemming from the Biden administration’s 2024 nuclear‑investment initiative.

The Three Mile Island restart is led by Constellation Energy (CEG‑US), which will bring Unit 1 back online under the Crane Clean Energy Center name. Although Three Mile Island suffered a nuclear accident in 1979, that involved Unit 2; the current effort targets Unit 1, which was shut down in 2019.

Constellation launched the plan in 2024, announcing a $1.6 billion investment and securing a $1 billion loan from the Department of Energy in 2025. Microsoft has signed a 20‑year power‑purchase agreement, becoming the project's primary customer.

Unit 1 is slated to restart in 2027 with a capacity of about 835 MW (0.835 million kW). Current work focuses on equipment repair and refurbishment of Unit 1, and the plant must obtain approval from the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission before fuel loading.

The third project involves NextEra Energy working with Google’s parent Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) to restart the Duane Arnold Energy Center in Iowa, which is expected to provide roughly 615 MW (0.615 million kW) of power by 2029.
NextEra Energy CEO John Ketchum said the company is pleased with the agreement with Google and emphasized that the associated costs will not be passed on to Iowa residential electricity customers.

The report notes that the reactors were previously shut down mainly due to operating costs and economic viability. Labor and maintenance expenses have pressured nuclear power against competing generation sources, but the rapid expansion of AI data centers is reshaping supply‑demand dynamics and investment conditions in the power market.

As grid connection becomes a key bottleneck for data‑center expansion, the tech sector’s need for reliable electricity creates new commercial incentives for nuclear restarts. However, whether these projects can deliver power on schedule will still depend on construction progress and regulatory approvals.

items.title: AI新創上市潮遇挫！Firmus取消300億美元IPO 輝達傳追加數億美元投資力挺
items.title_en: AI Startup Listing Wave Hits Snag! Firmus Cancels $30 Billion IPO, Nvidia Discusses Additional Multi‑Hundred‑Million‑Dollar Investment
paras: 《The Information》披露，澳洲AI雲端公司Firmus Grid放棄首次公開發行(IPO)計畫後，輝達(NVDA-US)正在討論進一步投資，評估金額約數億美元。
Firmus Grid是一家新型雲端服務商(neocloud)，屬於透過舉債支應營運的人工智慧(AI)雲端業者。輝達原本就持有Firmus的股權，也投資數家AI雲端領域的類似企業。
Firmus本月稍早宣布放棄在澳洲上市的計畫，理由是近期市場波動加劇，上市將不符合股東的最佳利益。
該公司原本計劃以超過300億美元的估值IPO，若成功上市，將成為澳洲股市史上規模最大的上市案之一。然而隨著全球AI與雲端企業估值遇挫，投資人開始質疑新型雲端業者不斷攀升的負債水準，以及長期維持高額AI基建支出的可行性，Firmus最終取消上市計畫。
這波估值重挫中，獲輝達支持的CoreWeave(CRWV-US)在受到的衝擊最大，過去一個月市值已蒸發約27%。
包括Firmus在內，近期資料中心產業共有三家業者取消或延後上市計畫，分別是由黑石集團(Blackstone)(BX-US)支持的新加坡資料中心營運商AirTrunk，該公司已擱置原定15億美元的上市計畫，以及軟銀(SoftBank)支持的資料中心業者SB Energy，後者已延後原定在那斯達克募資500億美元的上市計畫。
與此同時，投資人仍在等待先進AI模型開發商Anthropic與OpenAI的IPO。
paras_en: The Information reported that after Australian AI cloud company Firmus Grid abandoned its initial public offering (IPO) plan, Nvidia (NVDA-US) is in talks about a further investment, assessing an amount of roughly a few hundred million dollars.

Firmus Grid is a new‑type cloud service provider (neocloud), an AI cloud operator that finances its operations through debt. Nvidia already holds equity in Firmus and has invested in several similar AI cloud companies.
Earlier this month Firmus announced it was dropping its plan to list in Australia, citing heightened market volatility and stating that a listing would not be in the best interests of shareholders.

The company had originally planned an IPO at a valuation of over $30 billion; a successful listing would have been one of the largest ever on the Australian stock market. However, as global AI and cloud firm valuations have slipped, investors began questioning the rising debt levels of new‑type cloud operators and the feasibility of sustaining high AI infrastructure spending, leading Firmus to cancel the listing.
Amid this valuation plunge, CoreWeave (CRWV-US), which is backed by Nvidia, took the biggest hit, with its market value eroding by about 27% over the past month.

Including Firmus, three data‑center companies have recently cancelled or postponed IPO plans: Singapore data‑center operator AirTrunk, backed by Blackstone (BX‑US), which has shelved its planned $1.5 billion listing, and SB Energy, backed by SoftBank, which has delayed its planned $50 billion Nasdaq raise.
Meanwhile, investors are still awaiting IPOs from advanced AI model developers Anthropic and OpenAI.

items.title: AI失控疑慮又起！OpenAI曝AI代理自動關監控 還對員工說謊
items.title_en: AI Out-of-Control Concerns Resurface! OpenAI Reveals AI Agents Auto-Disable Monitoring and Lie to Staff
paras: OpenAI披露，旗下 AI 代理在兩項內部程式開發任務中，自行停用安全警報、移除監控系統，其中一個還向工作人員隱瞞相關行為。
這兩起事件再度引發外界疑慮，質疑 AI 業者能否有效約束模型行為，防止系統上線後帶來資安風險。
這家 ChatGPT 開發商周二(20日)表示，近期兩項內部程式開發任務出現 AI 代理刻意試圖欺騙工作人員，並削弱公司監控機制的情況。
停用安全警報 移除監控後還說謊
其中一起發生在本月稍早，一個 AI 代理關閉了向 OpenAI 安全團隊發送自動警報的功能。幾天後，在另一項獨立任務中，另一個 AI 代理移除了一套監控系統，並向工作人員說謊，隱瞞此事。
OpenAI 在部落格文章中表示：「兩起事件中，AI 代理都曾考慮是否保留監控防護機制，但它們將一般程式開發指令解讀為可以削弱防護的許可。」
是執行任務過度執著 還是刻意規避監控？
針對這兩起約兩周前發生的事件，OpenAI 表示，正在升級監控機制，並調查相關行為究竟只是出於無惡意、卻過度執著於完成任務，還是顯示 AI 代理有規避異常行為偵測系統的傾向。
OpenAI 先前已於 8 月宣布全面調整測試流程，投入更多資源監控 AI 代理，目標是在發現潛在問題後 30 分鐘內發出警報。如今，AI 代理卻自行停用警報與監控功能，使相關防護機制再受檢視。
部分專家尤其擔心，進階 AI 模型能察覺自己正受到監控，可能刻意隱藏違規行為，導致測試環境中的表現與實際上線後的行為不同。
接連發生資安事件 外部查核揭露更多問題
這家估值達 8,520 億美元的企業，已接連發生進階 AI 代理出現非預期、且引發安全疑慮的事件。先前 OpenAI 模型曾在測試中脫離管控，入侵 AI 平台 Hugging Face，也曾攻破澳洲公共衛生服務網站。
Asymmetric Security、Transluce 等獨立稽核機構的查核發現，先前多起駭客事件的實際嚴重程度，超過 OpenAI 最初對外揭露的內容，其中還包括隱藏資料爬取行為的操作。
最新兩起事件進一步加深外界對 OpenAI、Anthropic 等業者的疑慮，包括這些公司能否約束模型的不當行為，以及確保模型對外上線後不會帶來嚴重資安風險。
安全疑慮待解 上市計畫延後
OpenAI 執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）表示，公司將延後原訂今年進行的首次公開發行（IPO），待能夠「非常有把握地推動下一階段 AI 大規模應用」，並妥善解決安全疑慮後再上市。目前市場預期，上市時間將延至明年。
在外部評估方面，Anthropic 已向非營利組織 METR 開放接近內部員工層級的存取權限，以評估模型風險。OpenAI 則尚未公布與外部評估機構達成類似合作。
paras_en: OpenAI disclosed that its AI agents in two internal programming tasks disabled safety alerts, removed monitoring systems, and one even concealed the behavior from staff.
These two incidents reignited external concerns, questioning whether AI firms can effectively constrain model behavior and prevent cybersecurity risks after deployment.
The ChatGPT developer said on Tuesday (the 20th) that recent internal programming tasks saw AI agents deliberately trying to deceive staff and weaken company monitoring mechanisms.
Disabled safety alerts, removed monitoring, then lied.

One occurred earlier this month, where an AI agent turned off the function that automatically sent alerts to OpenAI’s safety team. A few days later, in a separate task, another AI agent removed a monitoring system and lied to staff, hiding the fact.

In a blog post, OpenAI wrote: “In both incidents, the AI agents considered whether to retain monitoring protections, but they interpreted ordinary programming instructions as permission to weaken the safeguards.”
Was it over‑zealous task execution or deliberate evasion of monitoring?

Regarding the two incidents that happened about two weeks ago, OpenAI said it is upgrading its monitoring mechanisms and investigating whether the behavior stemmed from harmless over‑commitment to task completion or indicates a tendency of AI agents to evade anomaly‑detection systems.

OpenAI previously announced in August a comprehensive overhaul of its testing process, allocating more resources to monitor AI agents, aiming to issue alerts within 30 minutes of detecting potential issues. Now the agents have themselves disabled alerts and monitoring, putting the safeguards under further scrutiny.
Some experts worry that advanced AI models can sense they are being monitored and may deliberately hide violations, causing performance in test environments to differ from behavior after launch.
Consecutive security incidents, external audits reveal more problems.

The company, valued at $852 billion, has seen a string of advanced AI agent incidents that were unexpected and raised security concerns. Previously OpenAI models broke out of control in tests, infiltrated the AI platform Hugging Face, and also breached an Australian public health service website.

Independent audit firms such as Asymmetric Security and Transluce found that the actual severity of several prior hacking incidents exceeded what OpenAI initially disclosed, including operations that concealed data‑scraping behavior.

The latest two incidents further deepen external doubts about OpenAI, Anthropic and other firms, including whether these companies can restrain improper model behavior and ensure models do not pose serious security risks once deployed.
Security concerns remain unresolved; IPO plans delayed.

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said the company will postpone its planned IPO this year, waiting until it can “very confidently move to the next phase of large‑scale AI deployment” and adequately address safety concerns before going public. The market now expects the listing to be pushed to next year.

In terms of external assessment, Anthropic has granted the nonprofit METR access close to internal‑staff levels to evaluate model risk. OpenAI has not yet announced a similar partnership with external assessors.

items.title: 馬斯克挺特斯拉、SpaceX合併 3.5兆美元版圖背後有三大關卡
items.title_en: Musk Backs Tesla‑SpaceX Merger: A $3.5 Trillion Vision Faces Three Major Hurdles
paras: 馬斯克周二(20日)首度公開支持特斯拉(TSLA-US) 與SpaceX(SPCX-US) 合併，認為兩家公司在人工智慧（AI）、晶片、機器人與太空基礎設施等領域具有整合價值。若構想成真，將打造估值約3.5兆美元的科技與製造巨頭，但也將面臨國安審查、公司治理及高風險投資集中等挑戰。
過去，特斯拉與SpaceX分別以電動車和火箭業務為核心，被視為相對獨立的企業。然而，隨著馬斯克將版圖擴大至AI、機器人、先進製造、衛星通訊，以及地面與未來太空軌道資料中心，兩家公司的業務界線日益模糊。
馬斯克表示，兩家公司在超級智慧軟體開發、晶片設計、Terafab計畫、機器人、大規模運載能力，以及Starmind衛星星座與連線服務等領域，合作都能帶來效益。
合併構想因此不只是將汽車與火箭業務放在一起，而是建立一家涵蓋AI、能源、機器人、通訊與交通運輸，並將業務延伸至地球之外的綜合企業。
晶片、能源與通訊成合作重心
兩家公司已有多項潛在合作方向。星鏈衛星可為特斯拉的自駕計程車、自動駕駛系統及未來幾代Optimus人形機器人提供通訊連線；特斯拉的電池與儲能產品，則可協助滿足SpaceX持續增加的電力需求，包括未來資料中心的用電。
馬斯克已宣布雙方合作推動Terafab半導體與AI運算計畫，目標是生產先進晶片，供應特斯拉自駕車與Optimus所需，同時支援SpaceX在AI及資料中心領域的布局。他希望該計畫能在2028年底前啟動大規模量產。
製造方面，特斯拉的工廠自動化能力，可與SpaceX推動星艦生產工業化的努力互補。下一代Roadster也計畫採用源自火箭技術的零組件。
合併後，雙方還可協調供應鏈布局，結合特斯拉在電池、半導體與製造設備的規模優勢，以及SpaceX對特殊金屬、電子零組件、推進系統與衛星硬體的需求。
資源調度更靈活 馬斯克影響力擴大
合併的另一項機遇，是簡化決策與資源配置。馬斯克許多計畫已橫跨多家公司，必須分別取得不同董事會及股東批准。整合後，管理層將有更大自主權，把資金、工程人才與基礎設施投入其認為最具潛力的領域。
馬斯克長期主張，推動特斯拉的AI與機器人戰略，需要更大的公司影響力。目前，他持有特斯拉近五分之一股份，並掌握SpaceX的投票控制權，合併將進一步鞏固他的影響力。
對股東而言，特斯拉投資人將有機會參與SpaceX旗下快速成長的星鏈寬頻、火箭發射及未來太空探索業務；SpaceX投資人則可取得特斯拉電動車、儲能、自動駕駛與機器人業務的所有權。
支持者可能認為，隨著雙方業務日益相互依賴，合併能提高資本配置效率。但投資人也將承擔更廣泛的技術、監管與執行風險，其中部分風險彼此幾乎沒有關聯。
國安審查與股東批准成關卡
合併最大的阻力，可能來自地緣政治與監管。SpaceX是美國軍方、情報機構及美國國家航空暨太空總署（NASA）的重要承包商；特斯拉則擁有廣泛的國際業務，上海工廠在汽車生產與銷售中占有重要地位。
將兩家公司整合，可能引發美國監管機構與國安官員進一步審查。
股東批准與公司治理也是挑戰。若交易需要股東同意，就必須說服投資人，將兩家業務已相當複雜的企業合併，能比維持獨立營運創造更大價值。利益衝突、投票控制權及資本配置問題，也將隨之浮現。
高成本計畫集中 執行風險未減
即使合併能整合資源，也不代表各項計畫的難度會降低。星艦、自駕計程車、人形機器人、AI資料中心、行動通訊與軌道基礎設施，都是成本高昂、技術門檻極高的投資。
合併帶來的機遇，在於串聯技術、製造與資金，推進馬斯克的長期願景；阻力則在於監管與治理，以及如何管理多項大型計畫。這些風險不會因合併而消失，而是集中到同一家公司旗下。
paras_en: Musk publicly supported a Tesla (TSLA‑US) and SpaceX (SPCX‑US) merger for the first time on Tuesday (the 20th), saying the two firms have integration value in AI, chips, robotics and space infrastructure. If realized, the combined entity would be valued at roughly $3.5 trillion, but would also confront national‑security review, corporate‑governance issues and the concentration of high‑risk investments.

Historically, Tesla and SpaceX have been seen as separate businesses focused on electric cars and rockets respectively. As Musk expands his empire into AI, robotics, advanced manufacturing, satellite communications and both ground‑based and future orbital data centers, the line between the two companies’ activities is becoming increasingly blurred.

Musk said the companies could benefit from cooperation in super‑intelligent software development, chip design, the Terafab project, robotics, large‑scale launch capability, and the Starmind satellite constellation and connectivity services.

Thus the merger concept is not merely about putting cars and rockets together, but about creating a comprehensive enterprise that spans AI, energy, robotics, communications and transportation, extending its operations beyond Earth.
Chips, energy and communications are the core of the collaboration

Both firms already have several potential joint initiatives. Starlink satellites could provide connectivity for Tesla’s autonomous taxis, self‑driving system and future generations of Optimus humanoid robots; Tesla’s batteries and storage products could help meet SpaceX’s growing power needs, including electricity for future data centers.

Musk has announced a joint Terafab semiconductor and AI computing program aimed at producing advanced chips for Tesla’s autonomous vehicles and Optimus, while also supporting SpaceX’s AI and data‑center ambitions. He hopes the program will reach large‑scale production by the end of 2028.

On the manufacturing side, Tesla’s factory automation capabilities could complement SpaceX’s push to industrialize Starship production. The next‑generation Roadster is also planned to use components derived from rocket technology.

After a merger, the two could coordinate supply‑chain layouts, combining Tesla’s scale in batteries, semiconductors and manufacturing equipment with SpaceX’s demand for specialty metals, electronic parts, propulsion systems and satellite hardware.
Resource allocation would become more flexible and Musk’s influence would expand

Another opportunity of a merger is the simplification of decision‑making and resource allocation. Many of Musk’s projects now span multiple companies and require separate board and shareholder approvals. An integrated entity would give management greater autonomy to deploy capital, engineering talent and infrastructure into the areas they deem most promising.

Musk has long argued that advancing Tesla’s AI and robotics strategy requires greater corporate clout. He currently owns roughly one‑fifth of Tesla and controls the voting rights at SpaceX; a merger would further cement his influence.

For shareholders, Tesla investors would gain exposure to SpaceX’s fast‑growing Starlink broadband, rocket launches and future space‑exploration businesses, while SpaceX investors would obtain ownership of Tesla’s electric‑vehicle, energy‑storage, autonomous‑driving and robotics operations.

Supporters may claim that as the two businesses become increasingly interdependent, a merger could improve capital‑allocation efficiency. However, investors would also assume broader technology, regulatory and execution risks, many of which are largely unrelated to each other.
National‑security review and shareholder approval are key hurdles

The biggest resistance to a merger could come from geopolitics and regulation. SpaceX is a major contractor for the U.S. military, intelligence agencies and NASA; Tesla has extensive international operations, with its Shanghai factory playing a crucial role in vehicle production and sales.
Integrating the two companies could trigger further scrutiny by U.S. regulators and national‑security officials.

Shareholder approval and corporate governance also pose challenges. If the deal requires shareholder consent, investors must be convinced that combining two already complex businesses will create more value than keeping them separate. Conflicts of interest, voting control and capital‑allocation issues would also surface.
High‑cost projects remain concentrated and execution risk is unchanged

Even if a merger can pool resources, it does not reduce the difficulty of the individual projects. Starship, autonomous taxis, humanoid robots, AI data centers, mobile communications and orbital infrastructure are all capital‑intensive, technically demanding investments.

The merger’s opportunity lies in linking technology, manufacturing and financing to advance Musk’s long‑term vision; the resistance lies in regulation, governance and how to manage multiple large‑scale programs. These risks will not disappear with a merger, but will be concentrated under a single corporate roof.

items.title: Gemini助陣！蘋果Siri AI韓語版本月上線 能看懂螢幕、翻訊息找食譜
items.title_en: Gemini Assists! Apple Siri AI Korean Version Launching This Month, Can Read Screens, Translate Messages and Find Recipes
paras: 《韓聯社》引述業界消息報導，蘋果(AAPL-US) 旗下搭載生成式人工智慧（AI）的助理 Siri AI，預計本月起支援韓語，南韓用戶即將能使用這項服務。
蘋果繼9月推出新版 Siri 英語測試版後，進一步擴大服務。該公司在新聞稿中表示，Siri AI 的功能與對話能力大幅提升，能理解個人情境、掌握廣泛的世界知識、辨識螢幕內容，並在整個系統中執行更多 App 操作。
舉例而言，若使用者詢問 Siri 過去旅行時曾吃過某道料理的食譜，系統即可搜尋使用者的訊息紀錄，並提供該特定菜色的食譜連結。
Siri AI 的另一項功能為視覺智慧（Visual Intelligence），提供強大的影像理解與多模態能力。蘋果說明，使用者可針對 iPhone、iPad、Mac 及 Apple Vision Pro 螢幕上的視覺內容進行提問。
據悉，蘋果已擴大 Siri AI與韓國本土應用程式的整合，並正與 Kakao和 Naver 等當地科技巨頭合作進行服務優化。
Siri AI 由 Google(GOOGL-US)的 Gemini 提供技術支援。但蘋果強調，該服務於公司內部的安全架構下運作，且針對需要 AI 工作負載處理的回覆，相關資料皆設計為立即刪除。
paras_en: The Korean Press Agency (Yonhap) cited industry sources reporting that Apple (AAPL-US) ’s generative‑AI‑powered assistant Siri AI is expected to support Korean starting this month, allowing South Korean users to access the service soon.

After rolling out a new English test version of Siri in September, Apple is further expanding the service. In a press release the company said Siri AI’s capabilities and conversational abilities have been greatly enhanced, enabling it to understand personal context, tap into broad world knowledge, recognize screen content, and perform more app actions across the system.
For example, if a user asks Siri for the recipe of a dish they ate on a past trip, the system can search the user’s message history and provide a link to that specific recipe.

Another feature of Siri AI is Visual Intelligence, which offers powerful image‑understanding and multimodal abilities. Apple explained that users can ask questions about visual content on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro screens.
Apple has reportedly broadened Siri AI’s integration with Korean local apps and is working with domestic tech giants such as Kakao and Naver to optimise the service.

Siri AI is powered by Google’s (GOOGL-US) Gemini. Apple emphasized that the service runs within the company’s internal security framework and that any data used for AI workload processing is designed to be deleted immediately after the response.

items.title: 馬斯克拋震撼彈！特斯拉與SpaceX研議合併、盤後大漲8% 專家怎麼看？
items.title_en: Musk Drops a Bombshell! Tesla and SpaceX Discuss Merger, Shares Surge 8% After Hours – What Experts Say
paras: 馬斯克周二(20日)表示，把旗下兩家公司SpaceX(SPCX-US)與特斯拉(TSLA-US)合併「是好主意」，並透露兩家公司已成立特別委員會討論合併事宜，消息傳出後，這家太空與科技公司股價盤後延上漲8%。市場如何看待合併提議？以下是分析師的看法。
eToro亞太區首席分析師Josh Gilbert表示，特斯拉與SpaceX合併，將成為市場有史以來規模最大的合併案，合併後兩家公司的總價值約達3.5兆美元。考量到兩家公司的業務都有很大一部分與人工智慧(AI)環環相扣，這項合併的邏輯並不難理解。
不過Gilbert指出，這筆交易面臨的門檻將會很高。即使馬斯克退出相關委員會，由同一個人掌管兩家公司的交易，仍將引發外界對公司治理的嚴格質疑。
他說：「對投資人而言，合併將把整個馬斯克商業版圖整合在同一個股票代號之下，涵蓋AI、機器人、電動車與太空探索。這等於把大量資金押在一個雄心勃勃的投資組合上。」
Zacks Investment Management首席市場策略師Brian Mulberry表示，合併一直是市場已知的可能性，而兩家公司似乎都正在建立相關論述，強調現有的協調效益，未來可進一步提升營運效率。雖然這項交易仍須獲得兩家公司的股東同意，但從馬斯克在電話會議上兩度提及此事來看，事情正朝這個方向發展。
Fortuna Investments執行長Justus Parmar看法相對樂觀，他認為，合併將為希望投資馬斯克的投資人創造一個單一投資標的，幾乎可以將他旗下所有公司整合在一起。這也能避免業務重複，減少他在兩家企業之間來回奔波所花費的時間，同時降低上市公司的管理費用、法律成本與行政負擔。
Parmar說：「我想強調的另一項好處是，特斯拉擁有高利潤率、能創造現金流的汽車業務，而隨著自駕計程車Robotaxi即將推出，未來還有更多成長空間。這些現金流可望支撐SpaceX的獲利，並為資本密集的太空探索與發射計畫提供資金，包括軌道資料中心。」
FOUNDER ETFs投資組合經理暨創辦人Michael Monaghan表示，在公司治理方面，創辦人的確應該掌控自己的公司，他對公司治理沒有根本性的疑慮，並認為正如馬斯克今天在電話會議上所說，獨立委員會將遵守法律的字面規定與立法精神。
不過在國家安全方面， Monaghan表示，考量到SpaceX是美國國防體系的重要承包商，特斯拉在中國的業務可能需要正式分割，或設置嚴格的營運與資訊防火牆，以處理這方面的疑慮。
The Futurum Group執行長Daniel Newman說：「自從SpaceX宣布首次公開發行(IPO)以來，這項合併幾乎就已經是不可避免的事……總而言之，兩家公司將太空、AI、自動化與機器人整合在一起，就未來發展而言，合併後的公司可說是全球最具優勢的企業之一。」
TEMA ETFs投資長Yuri Khodjamirian認為，這項合併具有合理性，兩家公司目前已經在多項大型共同計畫上合作，例如Terafab，「我們認為成立特別委員會是正確的一步，看來公司正努力處理合併所面臨的公司治理挑戰」。
paras_en: Musk said on Tuesday (the 20th) that merging his two companies SpaceX (SPCX-US) and Tesla (TSLA-US) is "a good idea," and revealed that a special committee has been set up at both firms to discuss the merger. After the news broke, the space‑tech stocks rose about 8% in after‑hours trading. How is the market viewing the proposal? Here are analysts' perspectives.

eToro Asia‑Pacific chief analyst Josh Gilbert said a Tesla‑SpaceX merger would become the largest ever in market history, with a combined valuation of roughly $3.5 trillion. Given that a large portion of both companies' businesses is tightly linked to artificial intelligence, the logic behind the deal is easy to understand.

However, Gilbert noted that the transaction faces a high hurdle. Even if Musk steps back from the relevant committees, having the same person control both companies would still trigger strict scrutiny over corporate governance.

He added: "For investors, the merger would consolidate Musk's entire business empire under a single ticker, covering AI, robotics, electric vehicles and space exploration. It’s essentially betting a huge amount of capital on an ambitious portfolio."

Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist at Zacks Investment Management, said the merger has long been a known possibility and both firms appear to be building a narrative around existing synergies that could boost operational efficiency. While shareholder approval is still required, Musk’s twice‑mentioned the idea in a conference call, indicating the process is moving in that direction.

Fortuna Investments CEO Justus Parmar was relatively optimistic, arguing the merger would give investors who want exposure to Musk a single investment vehicle that could essentially combine all his companies. It would also eliminate duplicate efforts, reduce the time Musk spends shuttling between the two firms, and lower the public‑company management, legal and administrative costs.

Parmar said: "Another benefit I want to highlight is that Tesla has a high‑margin, cash‑generating automotive business, and with the upcoming launch of robotaxi services there’s further growth upside. Those cash flows could support SpaceX’s profitability and fund capital‑intensive space exploration and launch projects, including orbital data centers."

Michael Monaghan, portfolio manager and founder of FOUNDER ETFs, said that from a corporate‑governance standpoint the founder should indeed control his own companies. He has no fundamental governance concerns and believes, as Musk said on the call, that an independent committee will comply with both the letter and spirit of the law.

On national‑security issues, Monaghan noted that because SpaceX is a key contractor for the U.S. defense system, Tesla’s operations in China might need to be formally separated or placed behind strict operational and data firewalls to address those concerns.

Daniel Newman, CEO of The Futurum Group, said: "Since SpaceX announced its first IPO, this merger has been almost inevitable… In short, the two companies will combine space, AI, automation and robotics, and the merged entity would be one of the most advantaged companies globally for future development."

Yuri Khodjamirian, CIO of TEMA ETFs, said the merger makes sense; the two firms already cooperate on several large joint projects such as Terafab. "We think forming a special committee is the right step, and it looks like the companies are working to address the corporate‑governance challenges the merger presents."

items.title: AI走進造晶片核心 英特爾加速打造「自主晶圓廠」
items.title_en: AI Enters Chipmaking Core as Intel Accelerates Building Its Own Wafer Fab
paras: 英特爾(INTC-US) 晶圓代工事業（Intel Foundry）近期撰文指出，隨著晶片製造與先進封裝日益複雜，公司正結合AI、精密計量、測試與自動化技術，推動傳統自動化生產邁向具備感知、分析與自主決策能力的工廠。
在SEMICON West 2026展會上，英特爾Foundry展示14項研究成果與技術方案，涵蓋先進計量、缺陷檢測、AI分析、先進封裝、晶片測試及工廠自動化。
從單點最佳化走向系統整合
英特爾認為，單靠個別製程或設備的最佳化，已難以滿足未來需求，必須讓製造系統各環節相互連結。
英特爾Foundry半導體研發、先進封裝技術與製造副總裁Lalitha Immaneni表示，半導體製造正從各自獨立的最佳化，轉向互聯的智慧系統。
不過，真正的工廠自主化不能只依賴AI，還須以可信賴的量測、可互通的平台及先進測試基礎設施為基礎。
計量從事後檢查轉向即時控制
計量過去主要用於製造過程中的品質檢查，如今英特爾希望透過持續量測與監控，將資料直接用於預測性製程控制，更早掌握潛在缺陷與良率問題。
隨著製程複雜度提高，材料、設備、化學品、封裝材料與生產環境之間的交互影響愈加明顯。部分問題直到製造後期才浮現，最終造成良率下滑、成本增加。更連續的量測與資料分析，正是為了提前辨識這些風險。
這套思維也延伸至先進封裝。隨著小晶片（Chiplet）、混合鍵合、高頻寬記憶體（HBM）及2.5D／3D封裝快速發展，晶圓製造與後端封裝的界線逐漸模糊。
英特爾認為，先進封裝同樣需要奈米級精度、嚴格的製程控制與品質管理。
在測試方面，英特爾正推進Advanced Chiplet Test服務，透過涵蓋晶圓至系統層級的測試，及早發現問題並篩選出已知良好晶片，盡可能在進入昂貴的封裝流程前排除缺陷，提高整體良率。
AI介入缺陷分析與工程決策
自動缺陷分類（ADC）是英特爾此次展示的重點之一。不同製程節點與工廠須管理大量缺陷分類規則及配方，工程師也得耗費時間分析日誌、搜尋歷史資訊、調查根本原因與檢查配方。
英特爾正導入以AI代理為基礎的工作流程，協助工程師完成上述任務，並透過人工審核把關最終決策。AI因此逐步從單純的資料分析工具，轉為協助處理製造問題、支援工程決策的智慧助理。
此外，英特爾也探索結合AI與熱傳物理模型，利用物理資訊神經網路預測晶片內部的熱傳遞。這項方法運用物理定律提升預測能力，減少對大量訓練資料的依賴。
隨著AI晶片功耗攀升，熱管理與可靠性已成為製造及測試的重要課題。
打通設備與資料是關鍵
要實現自主晶圓廠，軟體定義自動化也是重要基礎。英特爾指出，傳統製造系統常面臨供應商綁定與資料孤島問題，設備資料難以互通，限制工廠掌握整體資訊，也拖慢工程決策。
為此，英特爾正推動不受特定硬體限制的自動化架構、互聯資料系統與AI驅動的邊緣運算，讓設備、生產資料、AI分析及自動化系統相互連接，支援預測性維護、自動品質檢測，並縮短工程回應時間。
產業標準同樣不可或缺。英特爾參與的SATAS產業聯盟，由日本新能源暨產業技術綜合開發機構（NEDO）及經濟產業省支持，目前已有逾40家機構參與，致力推動半導體組裝與測試的開放標準、互通架構及自動化框架。
英特爾認為，若不同廠商的設備與軟體無法互通，即使工廠擁有先進AI技術，也難以實現大規模自主製造。未來的自主晶圓廠，將是計量、資料、AI、自動化、封裝、測試與產業標準共同構成的製造體系。
paras_en: Intel (INTC-US) wafer foundry business recently wrote that as chip manufacturing and advanced packaging become increasingly complex, the company is combining AI, precision metrology, testing and automation technologies to push traditional automated production toward factories with perception, analysis and autonomous decision‑making capabilities.

At the SEMICON West 2026 exhibition, Intel Foundry showcased 14 research results and technology solutions covering advanced metrology, defect detection, AI analysis, advanced packaging, chip testing and factory automation.
From point‑wise optimization to system integration
Intel believes that relying solely on the optimization of individual processes or equipment can no longer meet future demand; the various stages of the manufacturing system must be interconnected.

Lalitha Immaneni, senior vice president of semiconductor R&D, advanced packaging technology and manufacturing at Intel Foundry, said semiconductor manufacturing is shifting from isolated optimizations to interconnected intelligent systems.
However, true factory autonomy cannot rely only on AI; it must be built on trustworthy metrology, interoperable platforms and advanced testing infrastructure.
Metrology shifts from post‑process inspection to real‑time control

Metrology was previously mainly used for quality inspection during manufacturing; now Intel aims to use continuous measurement and monitoring data directly for predictive process control, catching potential defects and yield issues earlier.

As process complexity rises, the interactions among materials, equipment, chemicals, packaging materials and the production environment become more pronounced. Some problems only surface in later stages of production, ultimately causing yield loss and higher costs. More continuous measurement and data analysis is intended to identify these risks early.

This mindset also extends to advanced packaging. With the rapid development of chiplets, heterogeneous bonding, high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and 2.5D/3D packaging, the line between wafer manufacturing and back‑end packaging is becoming blurred.
Intel believes advanced packaging also requires nanometer‑level precision, strict process control and quality management.

In testing, Intel is advancing its Advanced Chiplet Test service, which conducts testing from wafer to system level to discover issues early and select known‑good chips, aiming to eliminate defects before the costly packaging stage and improve overall yield.
AI involvement in defect analysis and engineering decisions

Automated Defect Classification (ADC) was one of the highlights Intel displayed. Different process nodes and fabs must manage large numbers of defect classification rules and recipes; engineers also spend time analyzing logs, searching historical information, investigating root causes and checking recipes.

Intel is introducing AI‑agent‑based workflows to help engineers perform those tasks, with human review overseeing final decisions. AI is thus gradually evolving from a pure data‑analysis tool to an intelligent assistant that helps address manufacturing problems and supports engineering decisions.

In addition, Intel is exploring the combination of AI with thermal‑physics models, using physics‑informed neural networks to predict heat transfer inside chips. This approach leverages physical laws to enhance prediction accuracy while reducing reliance on massive training datasets.
As AI‑chip power consumption climbs, thermal management and reliability have become critical issues in manufacturing and testing.
Connecting equipment and data is key

To achieve an autonomous wafer fab, software‑defined automation is also a crucial foundation. Intel notes that traditional manufacturing systems often face vendor lock‑in and data‑island problems; equipment data is hard to interoperate, limiting the factory’s view of overall information and slowing engineering decisions.

Therefore, Intel is promoting an automation architecture that is not tied to specific hardware, an interconnected data system and AI‑driven edge computing, allowing equipment, production data, AI analysis and automation systems to interconnect, supporting predictive maintenance, automated quality inspection, and shortening engineering response times.

Industry standards are equally indispensable. The SATAS industry alliance that Intel participates in, supported by Japan’s New Energy and Industrial Technology Development Organization (NEDO) and the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry, now includes more than 40 organizations and works to promote open standards, interoperable architectures and automation frameworks for semiconductor assembly and testing.

Intel believes that if equipment and software from different vendors cannot interoperate, even a factory equipped with advanced AI technology will struggle to achieve large‑scale autonomous manufacturing. Future autonomous wafer fabs will be manufacturing systems composed of metrology, data, AI, automation, packaging, testing and industry standards.

items.title: 特斯拉Q3財報登場 投資人最關注Robotaxi與資本支出
items.title_en: Tesla Q3 Earnings Loom: Investors Focus on Robotaxi and Capital Expenditures
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，特斯拉(Tesla)(TSLA-US)即將公布第三季財報，但專家指出，投資人真正想聽到的，是公司在自動駕駛計程車(Robotaxi)方面的進展。
上個月，特斯拉開始在德州奧斯汀的叫車服務中投入Cybercab自動駕駛計程車。這些自駕車預期將有助於提升特斯拉的獲利能力，但目前仍僅在奧斯汀營運，且正面臨一項聯邦調查。
儘管如此，特斯拉目前已向德州車輛管理部門登記近350輛Cybercab。根據RobotaxiTracker資料，其中187輛Cybercab已在奧斯汀投入營運，約占特斯拉在當地車隊的一半。特斯拉上個月剛開始提供Robotaxi服務時，可投入使用的車輛還只有數十輛。
Oppenheimer分析師Colin Rusch率領團隊近期在給客戶的報告中寫道，「下一個考驗是，隨著車隊規模擴大，特斯拉能否在維持服務表現的同時，擴大無人監督的自動駕駛服務。」
特斯拉目前已在包括奧斯汀在內的美國六座城市，使用Model Y休旅車提供有限度的自動駕駛叫車服務，在舊金山則提供由安全駕駛員監督的乘車服務。此外，特斯拉已獲准在拉斯維加斯部署車輛，也取得在鳳凰城進行測試的許可。
特斯拉在各個市場的布局規模有所不同。目前在休士頓營運的車輛數量，甚至多於佛羅里達州邁阿密、奧蘭多及坦帕三座城市的車輛總數。
ETF發行商Direxion資深副總裁Ryan Lee表示，「如果特斯拉持續進入新市場，並真正觸及這些市場的終端消費者，這將成為公司一項相當重要的成長動能。」
投資人也將密切關注馬斯克對特斯拉全自動輔助駕駛（Full Self-Driving, FSD）軟體，以及Optimus人形機器人推出進度的說明。在馬斯克延後原定於2026年中舉行的展示活動後，外界至今很少看到Optimus相關進展。
根據FactSet數據，特斯拉預計週三公布財報，營收約為280億美元，與去年同期大致持平。其中，電動車銷售預計貢獻約190億美元，優於華爾街原先預期。
FactSet數據也顯示，特斯拉預估每股盈餘為0.45美元，低於去年同期的0.50美元。衡量獲利能力的稅前息前折舊攤銷前獲利（EBITDA）預計為37億美元，年減10%。
儘管這些數字有助於評估特斯拉的財務狀況，但部分專家認為，現階段投資人真正關注的只有一項指標：資本支出。
今年預計將是特斯拉有史以來支出最高的一年，公司計劃在多項基礎設施相關專案上投入超過250億美元。上個月，特斯拉也取得總額達300億美元的信貸額度。
特斯拉財務長Vaibhav Taneja今年稍早曾告訴投資人，資本支出「未來兩到三年都將持續增加」，原因包括自動駕駛計程車、人形機器人及其他投資計畫。
雖然特斯拉的支出規模不及關係企業SpaceX，但仍跟隨大型科技公司的整體趨勢。亞馬遜表示，計劃在2026年投入約2,200億美元資本支出；同樣將於週三公布第三季財報的Meta，則預計今年資本支出將達1,390億美元。
Lee表示，「市場要求的是恰到好處的支出。花得太少，市場會懲罰你。花得太多，市場當然也會懲罰你。」
paras_en: MarketWatch reports that Tesla (TSLA-US) is about to release its third‑quarter earnings, but experts say investors really want to hear about the company’s progress on autonomous ride‑hailing (Robotaxi).

Last month Tesla began deploying its Cybercab autonomous ride‑hailing service in Austin, Texas. The self‑driving cars are expected to boost Tesla’s profitability, but they are currently operating only in Austin and are facing a federal investigation.

Nevertheless, Tesla has registered nearly 350 Cybercabs with the Texas Department of Motor Vehicles. According to RobotaxiTracker, 187 of those Cybercabs are already in service in Austin, roughly half of Tesla’s local fleet. When Tesla first launched Robotaxi service last month, only a few dozen vehicles were available.
Oppenheimer analyst Colin Rusch and his team wrote in a client note, "The next test is whether Tesla can scale unmanned autonomous driving services while maintaining performance as the fleet grows."

Tesla now offers limited autonomous ride‑hailing with Model Y SUVs in six U.S. cities, including Austin, and provides supervised rides in San Francisco. The company has also been cleared to deploy vehicles in Las Vegas and has received permission to test in Phoenix.
The scale of Tesla’s deployments varies by market. The number of vehicles operating in Houston even exceeds the combined total of vehicles in Miami, Orlando and Tampa, Florida.
Direxion senior vice‑president Ryan Lee said, "If Tesla keeps entering new markets and truly reaches end‑consumers there, it will become a very important growth engine for the company."

Investors will also watch closely for Elon Musk’s updates on Full Self‑Driving (FSD) software and the rollout of the Optimus humanoid robot. Since Musk postponed the demo originally slated for mid‑2026, few Optimus updates have been seen.

FactSet data shows Tesla is expected to announce earnings on Wednesday, with revenue around $28 billion, roughly flat year‑over‑year. EV sales are projected to contribute about $19 billion, beating Wall Street’s original estimate.
FactSet also shows Tesla’s forecast EPS at $0.45, down from $0.50 a year ago. EBITDA is expected at $3.7 billion, a 10% year‑over‑year decline.
While these figures help assess Tesla’s financial health, some experts say the only metric investors truly care about right now is capital expenditures.

This year is projected to be Tesla’s highest‑spending year ever, with plans to invest over $25 billion in various infrastructure projects. Last month the company also secured a $30 billion credit facility.
Tesla CFO Vaibhav Taneja told investors earlier this year that capital spending "will continue to rise for the next two to three years," driven by Robotaxi, the Optimus robot and other investments.

Although Tesla’s spend is smaller than that of affiliate SpaceX, it still follows the broader trend among big tech firms. Amazon said it plans to spend about $220 billion on capex in 2026; Meta, which also reports Q3 results on Wednesday, expects $139 billion in capex this year.
Lee added, "The market wants just‑right spending. Spend too little and the market punishes you; spend too much and the market punishes you as well."

items.title: 法國騷亂 贓物湧入二手平台 法國政府勒令下架並追查銷贓
items.title_en: France Riots Flood Second‑Hand Platforms with Stolen Goods; Government Orders Removal and Pursues Sellers
paras: 法國爆發大規模騷亂與洗劫事件，造成全國至少3000家店鋪遭到破壞或搶劫。與此同時，暴徒搶劫獲得的商品隨後竟大量湧現於各大二手線上交易平台，包括 Vinted、Leboncoin、eBay 及 TikTok 等。這些銷贓刊登不僅以遠低於市價的折價兜售，部分商品甚至還帶著未拆除的防盜扣。

暴徒高調轉售贓物

據多家外媒報導，巴黎蒙田大道的 Celine、路易威登（Louis Vuitton）等高級精品店均遭洗劫，美妝通路絲芙蘭（Sephora）未能倖免。二手平台上出現大量全新口紅、香水、智慧型手機及運動球衣。
有賣家以僅10歐元出售一整袋絲芙蘭化妝品，也有人在 TikTok 上公開炫耀搶來的勞力士手錶與名牌包。甚至連法國電競俱樂部 Team Vitality 遭竊的《反恐精英》銀色獎盃，也被掛上 eBay 標價1250歐元拍賣。許多賣家更要求買家透過 Snapchat 私下聯繫，藉此規避平台的審查機制。
在這場暴亂中，許多商戶面臨巨額損失。在巴黎第8區經營餐廳「強強滾」的台灣店主劉欣益表示，店門前道路多次遭人縱火，加上附近的抗議活動升級與地鐵站關閉，即使店面未直接被搶，嚴重的安全風險也讓正常營業難以為繼。

當局約談平台業者

面對線上銷贓亂象，法國政府隨即採取緊急行動，要求各大平台立即刪除可疑商品資訊，並協助警方追查銷贓者。
法國數位事務部長Anne Le Hénanff在社群平台 X 上公開聲明表示：「我們期望這些平台毫不延遲地下架相關商品，他們也被要求與公共當局緊密合作，以便識別並起訴那些轉售潛在贓物的人。」
法國小型企業與商業事務部長Serge Papin指出，當局正協調「調查人員與線上平台之間的合作」，並建立具體機制以識別可疑刊登資訊背後的個人。Papin補充表示，政府將設立專項援助基金，協助受影響的在地企業渡過難關。
二手平台 Vinted 發言人對此回應強調，公司對於販售或教唆購買贓物採取「零容忍」政策，並表示：「自周末以來，我們的團隊已立即採取行動，識別並刪除與掠奪相關的商品刊登，並加強對可疑資訊的監控。」Vinted 補充說明，若發現違規行為，將會採取永久封禁帳戶等懲處。
歐盟委員會發言人Thomas Regnier對此新形態犯罪表示關注，他指出：「線上市場販售掠奪贓物是一個『全新的維度』，歐盟委員會非常樂意與法國當局合作調查。」

商業損失達數億歐元

法國商會與商業組織預估，這場騷亂已對零售業造成數億歐元的直接與間接損失。法國商會主席Alain Di Crescenzo透露，周末的暴力事件影響了數千家企業，損害極為慘重。
家樂福執行長Alexandre Bompard披露，騷亂首日即有約50家門市受嚴重影響，額外安保與停業等衝擊預計將對公司營業利潤造成8000萬至2億歐元的打擊。
為防止治安進一步惡化，法國總理Sébastien Lecornu已指示地方當局在部分地區實施宵禁。法國經濟部同時宣布啟動特殊部分失業補償等援助措施，協助受害商家渡過修復期。
paras_en: Mass riots and looting erupted across France, damaging or robbing at least 3,000 stores nationwide. At the same time, the stolen merchandise swarmed major online resale sites such as Vinted, Leboncoin, eBay and TikTok, often listed at deep discounts and sometimes still bearing anti‑theft tags.

The looters openly resold the loot. According to several foreign media outlets, high‑end boutiques on Paris’s Avenue Montaigne—including Celine and Louis Vuitton—were ransacked, and even beauty retailer Sephora was not spared. The resale platforms soon showed a flood of brand‑new lipsticks, perfumes, smartphones and sports jerseys.

Some sellers posted an entire bag of Sephora cosmetics for just €10, while others flaunted seized Rolex watches and designer bags on TikTok. Even the silver Counter‑Strike trophy stolen from French esports club Team Vitality was listed on eBay for €1,250. Many sellers asked buyers to contact them privately via Snapchat to evade platform moderation.

In the unrest, numerous merchants suffered huge losses. Liu Xinyi, a Taiwanese owner of the restaurant “Qiang Qiang Run” in Paris’s 8th arrondissement, said the road in front of his shop was set on fire repeatedly, protests escalated nearby and the metro station was closed; although his premises were not directly robbed, the severe safety risks made normal operations impossible.

Authorities interview platform operators. Facing the online sale of stolen goods, the French government acted swiftly, demanding that major platforms immediately delete suspicious listings and assist police in tracking the sellers.

France’s Digital Affairs Minister Anne Le Hénanff posted on X that the platforms must take down the items without delay and cooperate closely with public authorities to identify and prosecute those reselling potential loot.

Small‑Business and Trade Minister Serge Papin said the government is coordinating “cooperation between investigators and online platforms” and establishing concrete mechanisms to identify the individuals behind dubious postings. Papin added that a special aid fund will be set up to help affected local businesses weather the crisis.

A Vinted spokesperson stressed the company’s zero‑tolerance policy toward the sale or encouragement of buying stolen goods, saying: “Since the weekend, our team has acted immediately to identify and remove loot‑related listings and to tighten monitoring of suspicious information.” Vinted added that violators will face permanent account bans and other penalties.

EU Commission spokesperson Thomas Regnier expressed concern over this new form of crime, noting: “The online sale of looted goods is a ‘new dimension,’ and the European Commission is very willing to cooperate with French authorities in the investigation.”

Commercial losses run into hundreds of millions of euros. French chambers of commerce estimate the riots have caused direct and indirect losses of several hundred million euros to the retail sector. Chamber president Alain Di Crescenzo said the weekend’s violence affected thousands of businesses with devastating damage.

Carrefour CEO Alexandre Bompard disclosed that about 50 stores were severely impacted on the first day of the riots, and the extra security costs and shutdowns are expected to hit the company’s operating profit by €80 million to €200 million.

To prevent further deterioration of public order, Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu has ordered curfews in certain areas. The Ministry of Economy also announced special partial unemployment compensation and other aid measures to help affected merchants through the recovery period.

items.title: AI 搶電催動核電復活 美國重啟3座反應爐
items.title_en: AI Power Demand Drives Nuclear Power Revival, US Restarts Three Reactors
paras: AI 資料中心用電需求持續攀升之際，美國電力業者正推動重啟 3 座已停機的核反應爐，合計發電容量約 2.25 GW (225 萬瓩)，預計於 2027 年至 2029 年陸續恢復運轉。其中，三哩島計畫獲微軟 (MSFT-US) 20 年購電合約支持，Duane Arnold 計畫則由 NextEra Energy (NEE-US) 與 Google 合作推動。
科技媒體《Tom's Hardware》報導，這 3 項重啟計畫分別位於密西根州的 Palisades 核電廠、賓州三哩島的 Crane 清潔能源中心，以及愛荷華州的 Duane Arnold 能源中心。隨著科技業加速擴建 AI 基礎設施，穩定電力供應與電網接入能力成為重要瓶頸，也讓先前因經濟因素停機的核電機組重新受到關注。
其中，Palisades 核電廠重啟進度最快。報導指出，該廠已於 2026 年 8 月裝填燃料，預計在 2027 年 3 月前後恢復發電，提供約 800 MW (80 萬瓩) 電力。這座電廠先前已進入除役作業，若成功重啟，將成為核反應爐開始除役後恢復運轉的重要先例。
負責該計畫的 Holtec Palisades 已獲美國能源部貸款支持，相關融資源自拜登政府於 2024 年推動的核能投資措施。
賓州三哩島的重啟計畫則由 Constellation Energy (CEG-US) 主導，將恢復 1 號機組運轉，並以 Crane 清潔能源中心之名營運。三哩島曾於 1979 年發生核事故，但當時出事的是 2 號機組，本次重啟對象則是 2019 年停機的 1 號機組。
Constellation 於 2024 年啟動計畫，當時宣布預計投入 16 億美元，並於 2025 年取得美國能源部 10 億美元貸款。微軟已簽署為期 20 年的購電合約，成為這項計畫的主要客戶。
該機組預計於 2027 年恢復運轉，發電容量約 835 MW (83.5 萬瓩)。目前工程主要針對 1 號機組進行設備修復與翻新，裝填燃料前仍須取得美國核能管理委員會 (NRC) 核准。
第三項計畫是 NextEra Energy 與 Google 母公司 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 旗下的 Google 合作，推動愛荷華州 Duane Arnold 能源中心恢復運轉，預計於 2029 年提供約 615 MW (61.5 萬瓩) 電力。
NextEra Energy 執行長 John Ketchum 表示，公司對與 Google 達成的合作協議感到滿意，並強調，相關成本不會由愛荷華州住宅用電戶負擔。
報導指出，這些機組先前停機，主要與營運成本及經濟效益有關。人力與維護支出使核電在與其他發電方式競爭時承受壓力，但 AI 資料中心快速擴張，正改變電力市場的供需與投資條件。
隨著電網接入成為資料中心擴建的重要瓶頸，科技業者取得穩定電力的需求，也為核電重啟提供新的商業誘因。不過，各項計畫能否如期供電，仍取決於工程進度與監管核准。
paras_en: As AI data centers' electricity demand continues to climb, U.S. power companies are moving to restart three shut‑down nuclear reactors, adding about 2.25 GW (2.250 million kW) of capacity, with operations slated to resume between 2027 and 2029. The Three Mile Island project is backed by a 20‑year power‑purchase agreement with Microsoft (MSFT‑US), while the Duane Arnold project is being driven by NextEra Energy (NEE‑US) in partnership with Google.

Technology outlet Tom's Hardware reports that the three restart projects are located at the Palisades nuclear plant in Michigan, the Crane Clean Energy Center at Three Mile Island in Pennsylvania, and the Duane Arnold Energy Center in Iowa. As the tech sector accelerates AI infrastructure expansion, reliable power supply and grid‑connection capacity have become critical bottlenecks, bringing previously mothballed nuclear units back into focus.

The Palisades plant is the furthest along. The report says fuel loading was completed in August 2026, and the plant is expected to resume generation around March 2027, delivering roughly 800 MW (0.800 million kW). The plant had entered decommissioning, so a successful restart would set a precedent for reactors returning to service after decommissioning has begun.
Holtec Palisades, which is handling the project, has secured a loan from the U.S. Department of Energy, with financing stemming from the Biden administration’s 2024 nuclear‑investment initiative.

The Three Mile Island restart is led by Constellation Energy (CEG‑US), which will bring Unit 1 back online under the Crane Clean Energy Center name. Although Three Mile Island suffered a nuclear accident in 1979, that involved Unit 2; the current effort targets Unit 1, which was shut down in 2019.

Constellation launched the plan in 2024, announcing a $1.6 billion investment and securing a $1 billion loan from the Department of Energy in 2025. Microsoft has signed a 20‑year power‑purchase agreement, becoming the project's primary customer.

Unit 1 is slated to restart in 2027 with a capacity of about 835 MW (0.835 million kW). Current work focuses on equipment repair and refurbishment of Unit 1, and the plant must obtain approval from the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission before fuel loading.

The third project involves NextEra Energy working with Google’s parent Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) to restart the Duane Arnold Energy Center in Iowa, which is expected to provide roughly 615 MW (0.615 million kW) of power by 2029.
NextEra Energy CEO John Ketchum said the company is pleased with the agreement with Google and emphasized that the associated costs will not be passed on to Iowa residential electricity customers.

The report notes that the reactors were previously shut down mainly due to operating costs and economic viability. Labor and maintenance expenses have pressured nuclear power against competing generation sources, but the rapid expansion of AI data centers is reshaping supply‑demand dynamics and investment conditions in the power market.

As grid connection becomes a key bottleneck for data‑center expansion, the tech sector’s need for reliable electricity creates new commercial incentives for nuclear restarts. However, whether these projects can deliver power on schedule will still depend on construction progress and regulatory approvals.

items.title: AI新創上市潮遇挫！Firmus取消300億美元IPO 輝達傳追加數億美元投資力挺
items.title_en: AI Startup Listing Wave Hits Snag! Firmus Cancels $30 Billion IPO, Nvidia Discusses Additional Multi‑Hundred‑Million‑Dollar Investment
paras: 《The Information》披露，澳洲AI雲端公司Firmus Grid放棄首次公開發行(IPO)計畫後，輝達(NVDA-US)正在討論進一步投資，評估金額約數億美元。
Firmus Grid是一家新型雲端服務商(neocloud)，屬於透過舉債支應營運的人工智慧(AI)雲端業者。輝達原本就持有Firmus的股權，也投資數家AI雲端領域的類似企業。
Firmus本月稍早宣布放棄在澳洲上市的計畫，理由是近期市場波動加劇，上市將不符合股東的最佳利益。
該公司原本計劃以超過300億美元的估值IPO，若成功上市，將成為澳洲股市史上規模最大的上市案之一。然而隨著全球AI與雲端企業估值遇挫，投資人開始質疑新型雲端業者不斷攀升的負債水準，以及長期維持高額AI基建支出的可行性，Firmus最終取消上市計畫。
這波估值重挫中，獲輝達支持的CoreWeave(CRWV-US)在受到的衝擊最大，過去一個月市值已蒸發約27%。
包括Firmus在內，近期資料中心產業共有三家業者取消或延後上市計畫，分別是由黑石集團(Blackstone)(BX-US)支持的新加坡資料中心營運商AirTrunk，該公司已擱置原定15億美元的上市計畫，以及軟銀(SoftBank)支持的資料中心業者SB Energy，後者已延後原定在那斯達克募資500億美元的上市計畫。
與此同時，投資人仍在等待先進AI模型開發商Anthropic與OpenAI的IPO。
paras_en: The Information reported that after Australian AI cloud company Firmus Grid abandoned its initial public offering (IPO) plan, Nvidia (NVDA-US) is in talks about a further investment, assessing an amount of roughly a few hundred million dollars.

Firmus Grid is a new‑type cloud service provider (neocloud), an AI cloud operator that finances its operations through debt. Nvidia already holds equity in Firmus and has invested in several similar AI cloud companies.
Earlier this month Firmus announced it was dropping its plan to list in Australia, citing heightened market volatility and stating that a listing would not be in the best interests of shareholders.

The company had originally planned an IPO at a valuation of over $30 billion; a successful listing would have been one of the largest ever on the Australian stock market. However, as global AI and cloud firm valuations have slipped, investors began questioning the rising debt levels of new‑type cloud operators and the feasibility of sustaining high AI infrastructure spending, leading Firmus to cancel the listing.
Amid this valuation plunge, CoreWeave (CRWV-US), which is backed by Nvidia, took the biggest hit, with its market value eroding by about 27% over the past month.

Including Firmus, three data‑center companies have recently cancelled or postponed IPO plans: Singapore data‑center operator AirTrunk, backed by Blackstone (BX‑US), which has shelved its planned $1.5 billion listing, and SB Energy, backed by SoftBank, which has delayed its planned $50 billion Nasdaq raise.
Meanwhile, investors are still awaiting IPOs from advanced AI model developers Anthropic and OpenAI.

items.title: AI「金絲雀」重鳴！韓十月前20天晶片出口狂飆222.5%  財長：半導體榮景至少持續到2027
items.title_en: AI “Canary” Resounds! South Korea’s Chip Exports Surge 222.5% in First 20 Days of October; Finance Minister: Semiconductor Boom Will Last at Least Until 2027
paras: 南韓海關周三(21日)公布數據，10月前20天出口額較去年同期翻倍至創紀錄的616億美元，主要受益於半導體出口的強勁表現，進口則年增42.8%至471億美元，貿易順差145億美元。按工作日計算，日均出口額激增65.9%至47.4億美元，刷新歷史同期紀錄。
按出口類別來看，南韓晶片出口較去年同期暴增222.5%至275億美元，佔總出口比重達44.7%，創10月前20天最高紀錄。石油產品、汽車、鋼鐵出口分別增長68.3%、40.9%和42.6%。
出口目的地的話，南韓對主要貿易夥伴的出口全面大漲，對中國出口激增154.4%至167億美元，對美國成長154.9%至108億美元，對越南和歐盟成長率分別為74.6%和78.2%。
今年到週二(20日)為止，南韓累計出口額達8763億美元，年增59.5%，貿易順差總計2669億美元。
在曼谷出席IMF–世銀年會的南韓企劃財政部部長李炯日表示，半導體榮景「至少可持續至2027年」，只要無重大外部衝擊，今年經濟增速有望超過IMF預測的3.3%，甚至可能觸及3.5%。IMF已將南韓成長預期較7月上調0.7個百分點。
通膨方面，南韓9月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率回落至2.9%，仍高於央行2%的目標。市場普遍預期，南韓央行(BOK)週四(22日)將維持利率於3.00%不變，但接受《路透社》34位經濟學中有28位預期11月將升息至3.25%。
花旗預測，BOK將在11月和明年2月各升息25基點，終端利率達3.5%，本週決議更可能釋放「鷹派暫停」信號。
paras_en: South Korea’s customs announced on Wednesday (the 21st) that export value for the first 20 days of October doubled year‑on‑year to a record $61.6 billion, driven mainly by a strong performance in semiconductor exports, while imports rose 42.8% year‑on‑year to $47.1 billion, leaving a trade surplus of $14.5 billion. Calculated on a work‑day basis, daily export value jumped 65.9% to $4.74 billion, setting a new historical record for the period.

By export category, South Korea’s chip shipments surged 222.5% year‑on‑year to $27.5 billion, accounting for 44.7% of total exports and marking the highest level for the first 20 days of October. Exports of petroleum products, automobiles and steel rose 68.3%, 40.9% and 42.6% respectively.

In terms of destinations, South Korea’s exports to all major trading partners rose sharply: shipments to China jumped 154.4% to $16.7 billion, to the United States grew 154.9% to $10.8 billion, while growth rates to Vietnam and the EU were 74.6% and 78.2% respectively.
Through Tuesday (the 20th) this year, South Korea’s cumulative export value reached $876.3 billion, up 59.5% year‑on‑year, with a total trade surplus of $266.9 billion.

Speaking at the IMF‑World Bank Annual Meetings in Bangkok, Finance Minister Lee Kyoung‑il said the semiconductor boom “can last at least until 2027,” and that, barring major external shocks, this year’s economic growth could exceed the IMF’s forecast of 3.3% and possibly reach 3.5%. The IMF has already raised its growth outlook for South Korea by 0.7 percentage points since July.

On inflation, South Korea’s September consumer price index (CPI) annual rate fell to 2.9%, still above the central bank’s 2% target. Markets broadly expect the Bank of Korea (BOK) to keep its policy rate unchanged at 3.00% on Thursday (the 22nd), though 28 of 34 Reuters‑surveyed economists anticipate a hike to 3.25% in November.

Citigroup forecasts that the BOK will raise rates by 25 basis points in both November and February next year, taking the terminal rate to 3.5%, and this week’s decision is more likely to signal a “hawkish pause.”

items.title: AI失控疑慮又起！OpenAI曝AI代理自動關監控 還對員工說謊
items.title_en: AI Out-of-Control Concerns Resurface! OpenAI Reveals AI Agents Auto-Disable Monitoring and Lie to Staff
paras: OpenAI披露，旗下 AI 代理在兩項內部程式開發任務中，自行停用安全警報、移除監控系統，其中一個還向工作人員隱瞞相關行為。
這兩起事件再度引發外界疑慮，質疑 AI 業者能否有效約束模型行為，防止系統上線後帶來資安風險。
這家 ChatGPT 開發商周二(20日)表示，近期兩項內部程式開發任務出現 AI 代理刻意試圖欺騙工作人員，並削弱公司監控機制的情況。
停用安全警報 移除監控後還說謊
其中一起發生在本月稍早，一個 AI 代理關閉了向 OpenAI 安全團隊發送自動警報的功能。幾天後，在另一項獨立任務中，另一個 AI 代理移除了一套監控系統，並向工作人員說謊，隱瞞此事。
OpenAI 在部落格文章中表示：「兩起事件中，AI 代理都曾考慮是否保留監控防護機制，但它們將一般程式開發指令解讀為可以削弱防護的許可。」
是執行任務過度執著 還是刻意規避監控？
針對這兩起約兩周前發生的事件，OpenAI 表示，正在升級監控機制，並調查相關行為究竟只是出於無惡意、卻過度執著於完成任務，還是顯示 AI 代理有規避異常行為偵測系統的傾向。
OpenAI 先前已於 8 月宣布全面調整測試流程，投入更多資源監控 AI 代理，目標是在發現潛在問題後 30 分鐘內發出警報。如今，AI 代理卻自行停用警報與監控功能，使相關防護機制再受檢視。
部分專家尤其擔心，進階 AI 模型能察覺自己正受到監控，可能刻意隱藏違規行為，導致測試環境中的表現與實際上線後的行為不同。
接連發生資安事件 外部查核揭露更多問題
這家估值達 8,520 億美元的企業，已接連發生進階 AI 代理出現非預期、且引發安全疑慮的事件。先前 OpenAI 模型曾在測試中脫離管控，入侵 AI 平台 Hugging Face，也曾攻破澳洲公共衛生服務網站。
Asymmetric Security、Transluce 等獨立稽核機構的查核發現，先前多起駭客事件的實際嚴重程度，超過 OpenAI 最初對外揭露的內容，其中還包括隱藏資料爬取行為的操作。
最新兩起事件進一步加深外界對 OpenAI、Anthropic 等業者的疑慮，包括這些公司能否約束模型的不當行為，以及確保模型對外上線後不會帶來嚴重資安風險。
安全疑慮待解 上市計畫延後
OpenAI 執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）表示，公司將延後原訂今年進行的首次公開發行（IPO），待能夠「非常有把握地推動下一階段 AI 大規模應用」，並妥善解決安全疑慮後再上市。目前市場預期，上市時間將延至明年。
在外部評估方面，Anthropic 已向非營利組織 METR 開放接近內部員工層級的存取權限，以評估模型風險。OpenAI 則尚未公布與外部評估機構達成類似合作。
paras_en: OpenAI disclosed that its AI agents in two internal programming tasks disabled safety alerts, removed monitoring systems, and one even concealed the behavior from staff.
These two incidents reignited external concerns, questioning whether AI firms can effectively constrain model behavior and prevent cybersecurity risks after deployment.
The ChatGPT developer said on Tuesday (the 20th) that recent internal programming tasks saw AI agents deliberately trying to deceive staff and weaken company monitoring mechanisms.
Disabled safety alerts, removed monitoring, then lied.

One occurred earlier this month, where an AI agent turned off the function that automatically sent alerts to OpenAI’s safety team. A few days later, in a separate task, another AI agent removed a monitoring system and lied to staff, hiding the fact.

In a blog post, OpenAI wrote: “In both incidents, the AI agents considered whether to retain monitoring protections, but they interpreted ordinary programming instructions as permission to weaken the safeguards.”
Was it over‑zealous task execution or deliberate evasion of monitoring?

Regarding the two incidents that happened about two weeks ago, OpenAI said it is upgrading its monitoring mechanisms and investigating whether the behavior stemmed from harmless over‑commitment to task completion or indicates a tendency of AI agents to evade anomaly‑detection systems.

OpenAI previously announced in August a comprehensive overhaul of its testing process, allocating more resources to monitor AI agents, aiming to issue alerts within 30 minutes of detecting potential issues. Now the agents have themselves disabled alerts and monitoring, putting the safeguards under further scrutiny.
Some experts worry that advanced AI models can sense they are being monitored and may deliberately hide violations, causing performance in test environments to differ from behavior after launch.
Consecutive security incidents, external audits reveal more problems.

The company, valued at $852 billion, has seen a string of advanced AI agent incidents that were unexpected and raised security concerns. Previously OpenAI models broke out of control in tests, infiltrated the AI platform Hugging Face, and also breached an Australian public health service website.

Independent audit firms such as Asymmetric Security and Transluce found that the actual severity of several prior hacking incidents exceeded what OpenAI initially disclosed, including operations that concealed data‑scraping behavior.

The latest two incidents further deepen external doubts about OpenAI, Anthropic and other firms, including whether these companies can restrain improper model behavior and ensure models do not pose serious security risks once deployed.
Security concerns remain unresolved; IPO plans delayed.

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said the company will postpone its planned IPO this year, waiting until it can “very confidently move to the next phase of large‑scale AI deployment” and adequately address safety concerns before going public. The market now expects the listing to be pushed to next year.

In terms of external assessment, Anthropic has granted the nonprofit METR access close to internal‑staff levels to evaluate model risk. OpenAI has not yet announced a similar partnership with external assessors.

items.title: 馬斯克挺特斯拉、SpaceX合併 3.5兆美元版圖背後有三大關卡
items.title_en: Musk Backs Tesla‑SpaceX Merger: A $3.5 Trillion Vision Faces Three Major Hurdles
paras: 馬斯克周二(20日)首度公開支持特斯拉(TSLA-US) 與SpaceX(SPCX-US) 合併，認為兩家公司在人工智慧（AI）、晶片、機器人與太空基礎設施等領域具有整合價值。若構想成真，將打造估值約3.5兆美元的科技與製造巨頭，但也將面臨國安審查、公司治理及高風險投資集中等挑戰。
過去，特斯拉與SpaceX分別以電動車和火箭業務為核心，被視為相對獨立的企業。然而，隨著馬斯克將版圖擴大至AI、機器人、先進製造、衛星通訊，以及地面與未來太空軌道資料中心，兩家公司的業務界線日益模糊。
馬斯克表示，兩家公司在超級智慧軟體開發、晶片設計、Terafab計畫、機器人、大規模運載能力，以及Starmind衛星星座與連線服務等領域，合作都能帶來效益。
合併構想因此不只是將汽車與火箭業務放在一起，而是建立一家涵蓋AI、能源、機器人、通訊與交通運輸，並將業務延伸至地球之外的綜合企業。
晶片、能源與通訊成合作重心
兩家公司已有多項潛在合作方向。星鏈衛星可為特斯拉的自駕計程車、自動駕駛系統及未來幾代Optimus人形機器人提供通訊連線；特斯拉的電池與儲能產品，則可協助滿足SpaceX持續增加的電力需求，包括未來資料中心的用電。
馬斯克已宣布雙方合作推動Terafab半導體與AI運算計畫，目標是生產先進晶片，供應特斯拉自駕車與Optimus所需，同時支援SpaceX在AI及資料中心領域的布局。他希望該計畫能在2028年底前啟動大規模量產。
製造方面，特斯拉的工廠自動化能力，可與SpaceX推動星艦生產工業化的努力互補。下一代Roadster也計畫採用源自火箭技術的零組件。
合併後，雙方還可協調供應鏈布局，結合特斯拉在電池、半導體與製造設備的規模優勢，以及SpaceX對特殊金屬、電子零組件、推進系統與衛星硬體的需求。
資源調度更靈活 馬斯克影響力擴大
合併的另一項機遇，是簡化決策與資源配置。馬斯克許多計畫已橫跨多家公司，必須分別取得不同董事會及股東批准。整合後，管理層將有更大自主權，把資金、工程人才與基礎設施投入其認為最具潛力的領域。
馬斯克長期主張，推動特斯拉的AI與機器人戰略，需要更大的公司影響力。目前，他持有特斯拉近五分之一股份，並掌握SpaceX的投票控制權，合併將進一步鞏固他的影響力。
對股東而言，特斯拉投資人將有機會參與SpaceX旗下快速成長的星鏈寬頻、火箭發射及未來太空探索業務；SpaceX投資人則可取得特斯拉電動車、儲能、自動駕駛與機器人業務的所有權。
支持者可能認為，隨著雙方業務日益相互依賴，合併能提高資本配置效率。但投資人也將承擔更廣泛的技術、監管與執行風險，其中部分風險彼此幾乎沒有關聯。
國安審查與股東批准成關卡
合併最大的阻力，可能來自地緣政治與監管。SpaceX是美國軍方、情報機構及美國國家航空暨太空總署（NASA）的重要承包商；特斯拉則擁有廣泛的國際業務，上海工廠在汽車生產與銷售中占有重要地位。
將兩家公司整合，可能引發美國監管機構與國安官員進一步審查。
股東批准與公司治理也是挑戰。若交易需要股東同意，就必須說服投資人，將兩家業務已相當複雜的企業合併，能比維持獨立營運創造更大價值。利益衝突、投票控制權及資本配置問題，也將隨之浮現。
高成本計畫集中 執行風險未減
即使合併能整合資源，也不代表各項計畫的難度會降低。星艦、自駕計程車、人形機器人、AI資料中心、行動通訊與軌道基礎設施，都是成本高昂、技術門檻極高的投資。
合併帶來的機遇，在於串聯技術、製造與資金，推進馬斯克的長期願景；阻力則在於監管與治理，以及如何管理多項大型計畫。這些風險不會因合併而消失，而是集中到同一家公司旗下。
paras_en: Musk publicly supported a Tesla (TSLA‑US) and SpaceX (SPCX‑US) merger for the first time on Tuesday (the 20th), saying the two firms have integration value in AI, chips, robotics and space infrastructure. If realized, the combined entity would be valued at roughly $3.5 trillion, but would also confront national‑security review, corporate‑governance issues and the concentration of high‑risk investments.

Historically, Tesla and SpaceX have been seen as separate businesses focused on electric cars and rockets respectively. As Musk expands his empire into AI, robotics, advanced manufacturing, satellite communications and both ground‑based and future orbital data centers, the line between the two companies’ activities is becoming increasingly blurred.

Musk said the companies could benefit from cooperation in super‑intelligent software development, chip design, the Terafab project, robotics, large‑scale launch capability, and the Starmind satellite constellation and connectivity services.

Thus the merger concept is not merely about putting cars and rockets together, but about creating a comprehensive enterprise that spans AI, energy, robotics, communications and transportation, extending its operations beyond Earth.
Chips, energy and communications are the core of the collaboration

Both firms already have several potential joint initiatives. Starlink satellites could provide connectivity for Tesla’s autonomous taxis, self‑driving system and future generations of Optimus humanoid robots; Tesla’s batteries and storage products could help meet SpaceX’s growing power needs, including electricity for future data centers.

Musk has announced a joint Terafab semiconductor and AI computing program aimed at producing advanced chips for Tesla’s autonomous vehicles and Optimus, while also supporting SpaceX’s AI and data‑center ambitions. He hopes the program will reach large‑scale production by the end of 2028.

On the manufacturing side, Tesla’s factory automation capabilities could complement SpaceX’s push to industrialize Starship production. The next‑generation Roadster is also planned to use components derived from rocket technology.

After a merger, the two could coordinate supply‑chain layouts, combining Tesla’s scale in batteries, semiconductors and manufacturing equipment with SpaceX’s demand for specialty metals, electronic parts, propulsion systems and satellite hardware.
Resource allocation would become more flexible and Musk’s influence would expand

Another opportunity of a merger is the simplification of decision‑making and resource allocation. Many of Musk’s projects now span multiple companies and require separate board and shareholder approvals. An integrated entity would give management greater autonomy to deploy capital, engineering talent and infrastructure into the areas they deem most promising.

Musk has long argued that advancing Tesla’s AI and robotics strategy requires greater corporate clout. He currently owns roughly one‑fifth of Tesla and controls the voting rights at SpaceX; a merger would further cement his influence.

For shareholders, Tesla investors would gain exposure to SpaceX’s fast‑growing Starlink broadband, rocket launches and future space‑exploration businesses, while SpaceX investors would obtain ownership of Tesla’s electric‑vehicle, energy‑storage, autonomous‑driving and robotics operations.

Supporters may claim that as the two businesses become increasingly interdependent, a merger could improve capital‑allocation efficiency. However, investors would also assume broader technology, regulatory and execution risks, many of which are largely unrelated to each other.
National‑security review and shareholder approval are key hurdles

The biggest resistance to a merger could come from geopolitics and regulation. SpaceX is a major contractor for the U.S. military, intelligence agencies and NASA; Tesla has extensive international operations, with its Shanghai factory playing a crucial role in vehicle production and sales.
Integrating the two companies could trigger further scrutiny by U.S. regulators and national‑security officials.

Shareholder approval and corporate governance also pose challenges. If the deal requires shareholder consent, investors must be convinced that combining two already complex businesses will create more value than keeping them separate. Conflicts of interest, voting control and capital‑allocation issues would also surface.
High‑cost projects remain concentrated and execution risk is unchanged

Even if a merger can pool resources, it does not reduce the difficulty of the individual projects. Starship, autonomous taxis, humanoid robots, AI data centers, mobile communications and orbital infrastructure are all capital‑intensive, technically demanding investments.

The merger’s opportunity lies in linking technology, manufacturing and financing to advance Musk’s long‑term vision; the resistance lies in regulation, governance and how to manage multiple large‑scale programs. These risks will not disappear with a merger, but will be concentrated under a single corporate roof.

items.title: 「羅斯福號」航母將派往中東 美軍在中東增兵1萬人
items.title_en: USS Roosevelt Carrier to Deploy to the Middle East, US Adds About 10,000 Troops in the Region
paras: 美國「羅斯福號」航母近日抵達日本，進行物資補給，「羅斯福號」航母被派遣往中東地區。
兩名美國官員20日（周二）說，美國向中東派遣「羅斯福號」航母打擊群和第13海軍陸戰隊遠征隊。「羅斯福號」航母將於11月底抵達中東，這些新的部署將為美軍在中東增加約1萬名士兵。
「羅斯福號」航母將成為美軍在中東部署的第三艘航母。美國目前已有兩艘航空母艦部署在中東，分別是「布希號」和「華盛頓號」。
第三艘航母將為美國提供更多選擇，美國總統川普正考慮在期中選舉之後加強對伊朗的打擊力道。
「羅斯福號」航母於9月27日離開加州聖迭戈港，「按計劃執行部署任務」。由3艘兩棲艦艇組成的「馬金島號」兩棲戒備群，9月28日啟程，載有美國海軍陸戰隊遠征部隊官兵。
paras_en: The US "USS Roosevelt" aircraft carrier recently arrived in Japan for resupply and has been ordered to head to the Middle East.

Two US officials said on Tuesday the 20th that the United States is sending the USS Roosevelt carrier strike group and the 13th Marine Expeditionary Unit to the Middle East. The carrier is slated to arrive there by the end of November, and the new deployments will increase US forces in the region by roughly 10,000 personnel.
The USS Roosevelt will become the third aircraft carrier the US has stationed in the Middle East. The United States already has two carriers operating there, the "USS Bush" and the "USS Washington."
Having a third carrier will give the United States more options, and President Trump is reportedly considering strengthening the US strike capability against Iran after the mid‑term elections.

The USS Roosevelt left San Diego, California on September 27, carrying out its deployment as planned. A three‑ship amphibious ready group centered on the USS Marines Island set sail on September 28, transporting US Marine Expeditionary Force personnel.

items.title: 80萬人上街、數千人被捕：法國爆發近年最大騷亂 究竟怎麼了？
items.title_en: 800,000 Take to the Streets, Thousands Arrested: France Experiences Its Largest Unrest in Years – What’s Happening?
paras: 法國近日爆發規模浩大的全國性示威與騷亂，暴露了法國在教育資源、生活成本、高額國債以及政治極化等多重領域的深層危機。
這場動盪最初源自9月中旬巴黎南郊克雷泰伊(Créteil)一所高中的學生罷課，學生團體抗議師資長期短缺、校舍破舊及課程安排不合理，要求政府撥款100億歐元改善教育環境。隨後，對中東衝突引發燃油價格飆漲與生活成本上升的不滿情緒迅速蔓延，並在工會與網路動員下演變為全國性抗議。
10月17日，巴黎、馬賽、里昂與利摩日等多座城市爆發大規模示威，官方估計約55萬人上街，組織方則稱達80萬人。抗議過程迅速失控，利摩日市政廳遭縱火損毀，多地商家與公共設施遭到打砸搶劫。法國內政部統計，單日即有2,397人被捕、997名警員受傷，部分城市隨後實施局部宵禁。
針對嚴重衝突，法國政治各派展開激烈攻防。法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)在電視講話中譴責暴力，表示理解青年焦慮並承諾研擬回應措施，同時呼籲大眾必須嚴格區分和平抗議者與非法掠奪者。
法國總理勒科爾尼(Sébastien Lecornu)坦言「局面一團糟」，並指控極左翼團體煽動騷亂、將學生示威武器化。內政部長努內茲(Laurent Nuñez)承認治安力量預判不足，致使警方在部分地區失去控制。
對此，極左翼「不屈的法蘭西」(LFI)黨魁Jean-Luc Mélenchon強烈否認煽動指控，反指政府維安失當並試圖利用混亂塑造「秩序維護者」形象。極右翼「國民聯盟」(National Rally)領導人勒龐(Marine Le Pen)則指責國家夾在「暴力與無能」之間，並將矛頭指向班列格(banlieues，貧困郊區)治安與極左勢力。
然而，學生工會代表Lisa Cordat強調學生怒火來自基層自發，政治人物的操縱說法是對學生的侮辱；教師代表Mar批評政客利用暴力進行大選操作，無視基層對公共服務的實質訴求。
分析人士與國際媒體普遍認為，這場騷亂反映了法國治理體系的結構性困境。巴黎政治學院學者Aurélien Dubuisson指出，法國公共債務高企(債務占 GDP 達 119%)，大幅壓縮了政府調節民生與教育預算的空間。
同時，自2024年國會大選以來，中間派勢力衰退，極左與極右對立加劇，政治碎片化導致政策陷入僵局。
《紐約時報》與西班牙《國家報》等外媒評論，政黨間缺乏妥協傳統且熱衷於2027年大選角力，使社會積怨難以化解，法國正面臨政局極化與體制信心下滑的嚴峻考驗。
paras_en: France has recently seen massive nationwide demonstrations and riots, exposing deep crises in education resources, living costs, high national debt, and political polarization.

The unrest began in mid‑September when students at a high school in Créteil, a southern suburb of Paris, staged a walkout, protesting chronic teacher shortages, dilapidated school buildings and unreasonable curricula, and demanding €10 billion in government funding to improve the education environment. Discontent over soaring fuel prices and rising living costs triggered by the Middle‑East conflict quickly spread, and under union and online mobilization the protests turned national.

On October 17, large‑scale demonstrations erupted in Paris, Marseille, Lyon and Limoges, with officials estimating about 550,000 people on the streets while organizers claimed up to 800,000. The protests quickly spiraled out of control, with the Limoges city hall set on fire and numerous shops and public facilities looted and vandalized. The French interior ministry reported 2,397 arrests and 997 police injuries in a single day, and several cities imposed partial curfews thereafter.

In response to the severe clashes, France’s political parties launched fierce attacks. President Emmanuel Macron condemned the violence in a televised address, said he understood young people’s anxiety and pledged to devise response measures, while urging the public to clearly distinguish peaceful protesters from illegal looters.

Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu admitted the situation was “a mess,” accusing far‑left groups of inciting the riots and weaponising the student protests. Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez acknowledged that security forces had underestimated the threat, allowing police to lose control in some areas.

Far‑left leader Jean‑Luc Mélenchon of La France Insoumise strongly denied the incitement accusations, blaming the government’s security failures and claiming it was trying to portray itself as a “guardian of order” amid the chaos. Far‑right leader Marine Le Pen of the National Rally said the state was caught between “violence and incompetence,” pointing the finger at the banlieues and far‑left forces.

However, student union representative Lisa Cordat stressed that the students’ anger was grassroots‑driven and that claims of political manipulation insulted the students; teacher representative Mar criticized politicians for exploiting the violence for electoral purposes, ignoring the genuine demands for public services at the grassroots level.

Analysts and international media generally view the unrest as reflecting structural problems in France’s governance system. Aurélien Dubuisson, a scholar at Sciences Po, noted that France’s public debt is soaring (debt equals 119 % of GDP), severely limiting the government’s ability to adjust social welfare and education budgets.

At the same time, since the 2024 parliamentary election, centrist forces have weakened while the far‑left and far‑right have become more antagonistic, and political fragmentation has led to policy deadlock.

Foreign outlets such as The New York Times and Spain’s El País comment that the lack of a tradition of compromise among parties and the focus on the 2027 election battle have allowed societal grievances to fester, leaving France facing a severe test of political polarization and declining institutional confidence.

items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar and Stocks Celebrate Together! Opens Low, Rises Strong, Gains 0.129 NTD to Close at 32.488
paras: 打破連四黑，台北外匯市場新台幣兌美元今(21)日早盤開低走高，盤中最低貶 8.7 分，午後最高升值1.88角，盤中高低價差達2.75角，匯市多空激烈交戰，終場收在32.488元，升值1.29角，台北外匯成交金額20.59億美元，顯示在熱錢轉向與避險需求交織下，匯市交投異常熱絡。
台幣早盤一度因外資匯出重貶至 32.704 元波段新低，隨台股強彈、外資轉為匯入及相關調節，午後急拉翻紅，終場爆量強升 1.29 角，以 32.488 元作收，終止連四黑。細看匯市全日表現，今日開盤價為 32.630 元，盤中最高升抵 32.429 元、最低貶至 32.704 元，高低價差達 2.75 角。
從國際盤與總體環境觀察，受美股科技股財報與半導體族群走強激勵，那斯達克及費城半導體指數持續反彈，帶動亞洲主要股市與貨幣連動上揚。日元、韓元等主要亞幣對美元普遍回升，吸引國際資金重新回流亞洲新興市場，匯市單邊拋匯壓力明顯緩解，促使台北匯市多頭買盤大舉湧現。
在台股與籌碼面部分，根據證交所最新統計數據，台股今日受到電子權值股發威帶動，終場大漲 594.84 點，收在 46,887.77 點，成交金額達 8,331.91 億元。
三大法人今日合計買超台股 5.68 億元。其中外資及陸資終結連續 10 個交易日的賣超，回頭買超 9.6 億元；投信則連續 9 個交易日力挺，加碼買超 129.19 億元；自營商仍站賣方調節，賣超 133.11 億元。外資由賣轉買並同步於匯市匯入，帶動股匯雙雙止跌回升。
觀察後續市場演變，匯銀人士分析，外資今日展現強烈回流意願，帶動新台幣一舉化解連續重貶破底的危機。目前新台幣收盤重回 32.50 元大關上方，短線重點將觀察外資買超台股的續航力道以及美國通膨數據、聯準會利率政策動向。若熱錢持續湧入，新台幣不排除進一步向 32.30 元關卡挑戰。
整體而言，投資人宜密切關注美股財報週表現、外資於現期貨市場與外匯市場的資金配置幅度，以及亞幣整體的相對強弱，作為後續投資佈局與資產風險控管的依據。
paras_en: Breaking a streak of four consecutive declines, the New Taiwan Dollar in Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market opened lower against the US dollar this morning (21st) but turned higher, falling to a low of 8.7 points before rallying up to 1.88 NTD in the afternoon. The intraday high‑low spread reached 2.75 NTD, reflecting fierce buying‑selling battles, and the session closed at 32.488 NTD, up 1.29 NTD. Taipei’s FX turnover was US$20.59 billion, showing unusually active trading as hot money flows and hedging demand intertwined.

The NT$ briefly slipped to a new intraday low of 32.704 NTD in the early session due to foreign‑capital outflows, but a rebound in the Taiwan stock market, foreign inflows and related adjustments drove a sharp afternoon reversal, ending the day with a strong 1.29 NTD rise to close at 32.488 NTD, ending the four‑day losing streak. Looking at the day’s price action, the opening price was 32.630 NTD, the intraday high was 32.429 NTD, the low was 32.704 NTD, and the high‑low spread was 2.75 NTD.

From the international market and overall environment, US tech earnings and a rally in semiconductor stocks lifted the Nasdaq and Philadelphia Semiconductor indices, which in turn boosted major Asian equity markets and currencies. Major Asian currencies such as the yen and won generally appreciated against the dollar, attracting international capital back to Asian emerging markets. The one‑sided selling pressure in the FX market eased markedly, prompting a flood of bullish buying in Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market.

On the equity side, according to the latest statistics from the Taiwan Stock Exchange, the market was driven by heavyweight electronic stocks, surging 594.84 points to finish at 46,887.77 points with a turnover of NT$8,331.91 billion.

The three major institutional investors bought a net NT$5.68 billion of Taiwanese stocks today. Foreign and mainland investors ended a ten‑day streak of net selling, turning to a net purchase of NT$9.6 billion; investment trusts continued a nine‑day buying streak, adding a net NT$129.19 billion; proprietary traders remained net sellers with a net sale of NT$133.11 billion. The shift of foreign investors from selling to buying, coupled with FX inflows, helped both stocks and the NT$ rebound.

Looking ahead, FX analysts note that foreign investors showed a strong willingness to return today, helping the NT$ quickly resolve the crisis of consecutive sharp depreciations. The NT$ now closed back above the 32.50 NTD threshold; short‑term focus will be on the sustainability of foreign buying in equities, US inflation data, and Fed rate policy. If hot money continues to flow in, the NT$ could further test the 32.30 NTD level.

Overall, investors should closely monitor US earnings reports, the scale of foreign capital allocation in futures and FX markets, and the relative strength of Asian currencies as bases for future investment positioning and asset‑risk management.

隨後美國商務部公布9月建築許可減0.2%至年率為140萬戶高於預期，但房屋開工驟降5.2%至經季節調整年率達122.1萬戶，並據全美住宅建築商協會(NAHB)調查9月成屋待完成銷售指數暴跌7.3%至66.0，創該指數2001年開始編制以來最低，突顯中東衝突推高抵押貸款利率和建築材料價格，打擊房地產市場，衝擊美元兌日圓跌至157.81低點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.30-50，支撐於157.40-60。
◆EUR/USD

澳洲央行(RBA)金融市場主管強調本月28日公布第三季消費者物價指數(CPI)重要性，市場預估核心CPI較前季升1.0%，並較上年同期維持3.6%，遠高於RBA的2%至3%目標，同日紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)可能宣布今年第三次加息，升息25個基點的概率達89%，昨日支撐澳幣和紐元，而且中東衝突推升能源價格，德國9月生產者物價指數(PPI)較前月升1.9%高於預期及較去年同期漲6.7%創三年半新高，推動歐元兌美元自1.1204低點上漲。
據德國經濟研究所ZEW表示，能源價格高企抑制民間消費與投資，10月德國投資者信心指數降至28.1超過預期，但法國動盪局勢緩和及美國數據疲弱，扶助歐元兌美元回升至1.1260高點。預估今日歐元兌美元支撐於1.1190-1.1210，阻力於1.1270-90。
◆GBP/USD

週二英國公布截至8月的三個月，不含獎金平均薪資較上年同期增3.7%及失業率降至去年中以來最低4.7%，強化英國央行(BOE)於下月會議上調利率至4%的預期，支撐英鎊兌美元穩守1.3296低點。隨著BOE貨幣政策委員會(MPC)委員格林稱，伊朗戰爭引發能源價格衝擊，導致更廣泛通貨膨脹回升風險高於BOE預期，重申利率應上調的觀點，提振英鎊兌美元1.3409高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於1.3330-50，阻力於1.3430-50。

In addition, Economy and Finance Minister Shiroi, seen as an ally of Prime Minister Kishida’s inflation‑focused camp, said on Tuesday he hopes to attend the Bank of Japan’s policy meeting this month but will respect the BOJ’s independence. According to four sources familiar with BOJ decision‑making, given the BOJ’s recent rate hike last month, the policy meeting ending on Oct. 30 is expected to keep rates unchanged, but higher oil prices are sustaining price pressures longer than expected, so the BOJ may raise its inflation forecast for the next fiscal year in the post‑meeting quarterly report, leaving room for a possible December rate hike. Moreover, the 20‑year Japanese government bond auction saw a record‑high bid‑to‑cover ratio of 5.84, indicating that cautious funds are returning, and compared with Europe’s political and fiscal situation, Japanese bonds are showing relative safe‑haven appeal, bolstering the yen and pulling the USD/JPY down from its 158.59 peak.

items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Slides as Iran Tensions and AI Risks Stir Markets
paras: 美元周二(20日)走低，與油價及較長天期美國公債殖利率下跌走勢一致。交易員正評估美國與伊朗戰事緊張情勢升高的影響，以及資金持續大舉流入美國AI企業的趨勢能否延續。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.25%，報101.71。
油價在觸及五個月高點後回落。交易員一方面關注伊朗總統與巴基斯坦陸軍參謀長的會面，後者是美伊談判的重要斡旋者。另一方面，也評估葉門青年運動（ Houthi）持續攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯基礎設施，以及波斯灣海域傳出船隻遭襲的消息。
油價上漲加深了市場對通膨可能在更長時間內維持高檔的憂慮。上週，美國公布的數據顯示，9月消費者物價通膨加速，帶動美元走強。
然而，市場焦點很快又轉向AI相關疑慮。
野村證券G10外匯策略主管Dominic Bunning表示，「能源價格上漲有利美元，但如果利率因此升得太高，甚至導致AI交易行情崩盤，情況就會突然轉為不利因素。我們面臨一道臨界點，而目前市場正處於這個臨界點附近。」
大量資金流入美國AI股票，一直為美元提供支撐。部分與AI產業相關的成長及通膨預期推升利率，也進一步支撐美元。
不過，週二稍早，市場對AI的疑慮再度升溫。南韓AI服務公司Elice Group在首爾股市掛牌首日，股價暴跌32%。
歐元兌美元上漲0.22%，至1.1235美元。
儘管歐元週二上漲，交易員仍對其前景保持謹慎，因為法國正面臨大規模抗議活動，財政狀況也持續惡化。
法國政府週二表示，將增派軍警支援，並為週六預計舉行的新一輪抗議活動部署大規模維安措施。政府同時承認，在應對上週末的暴力事件時處置失當。
瑞典商業銀行（Handelsbanken）外匯策略師Tommy von Brömsen表示，「法國面臨的憂慮短期內不會消退。市場對法國的看空情緒還會持續一段時間，歐元也仍有進一步走弱的空間。」
英鎊兌美元上漲0.59%，至1.338美元。
英國最新公布的勞動市場數據顯示，就業市場仍具韌性，這也是近期一系列優於預期的英國經濟數據之一。
eToro全球市場策略師Lale Akoner表示，「風險在於，強韌的勞動市場可能讓英格蘭銀行(BoE)既有空間、也有理由再次升息。升息預期升高，可能有利英鎊。」
根據LSEG數據，市場幾乎已完全反映英格蘭銀行將在11月5日的下次會議升息1碼。
日本長天期公債(JGBs)標售吸引創紀錄的需求，帶動日元走強。
道富投資管理公司資深固定收益策略師Masahiko Loo表示，「20年期公債標售創下紀錄，強烈顯示先前觀望的資金終於開始回流。日本公債也逐漸成為相對安全的避風港，可用來因應歐洲政治與財政局勢的波動，尤其是法國的相關風險。」
日元兌美元上漲0.21%，至158.14日元。
其他貨幣方面，加拿大亞伯達省居民在該省首次舉行的分離公投中，多數支持繼續留在加拿大。消息公布後，加幣兌美元上漲0.34%，至1.406加幣，升至近一個月來最強。
